| | Here’s something you may not know: even if you think a candidate is the perfect fit for an organization to support, most won’t even consider a candidate until they’ve raised enough money to be “viable.” I learned this last year, when I was working in Congress and exploring a run for office. I reached out to a few different organizations focusing on electing folks like me – first time candidates, women, scientists, or people with a service background (I did AmeriCorps). On a call with one such organization, they mentioned off-hand that they didn’t even _consider_ endorsing a Congressional candidate until they’d raised $300,000. That number felt huge, because it is. Then (and now), the irony isn’t lost on me. **Orgs that are supposed to help you get support won’t help until you’ve proven you _already_ have support? ** I wish it didn’t work that way, but it does. We’re not running this campaign to satisfy someone else’s benchmark of success. We’re running it to serve our neighbors, bring joy and community back to politics, and get us the representation we deserve. But clearing this important threshold opens doors that will give us the resources we need to win. If we can show some of these groups that we’re a campaign worth putting their name behind, their support will unlock _more_ support that will help us flip this seat in November. And getting these nods sooner rather than later creates an exponential snowball effect over the next five months. **And as of today, we are just $4,929 away from that $300,000 threshold at which we can apply for some of these endorsements.** I'd love to be able to submit applications this week. clean_body: And we've almost reached it | | | Here’s something you may not know: even if you think a candidate is the perfect fit for an organization to support, most won’t even consider a candidate until they’ve raised enough money to be “viable.” I learned this last year, when I was working in Congress and exploring a run for office. I reached out to a few different organizations focusing on electing folks like me – first time candidates, women, scientists, or people with a service background (I did AmeriCorps). On a call with one such organization, they mentioned off-hand that they didn’t even consider endorsing a Congressional candidate until they’d raised $300,000. That number felt huge, because it is. Then (and now), the irony isn’t lost on me. Orgs that are supposed to help you get support won’t help until you’ve proven you already have support? I wish it didn’t work that way, but it does. We’re not running this campaign to satisfy someone else’s benchmark of success. We’re running it to serve our neighbors, bring joy and community back to politics, and get us the representation we deserve. But clearing this important threshold opens doors that will give us the resources we need to win. If we can show some of these groups that we’re a campaign worth putting their name behind, their support will unlock more support that will help us flip this seat in November. And getting these nods sooner rather than later creates an exponential snowball effect over the next five months. And as of today, we are just $4,929 away from that $300,000 threshold at which we can apply for some of these endorsements. I'd love to be able to submit applications this week. Can you help us get there? | | ~ In gratitude, Michaela P.S. If you want another way to help us flip this district, I hope you'll come to our~! Drop in anytime from 11 - 2 at Printshop Beer in South Knoxville. We'll have on-demand screen printing of Put Hope to Work (bring an old t-shirt or tote bag!), refreshments, and stations where you can learn how to reach voters through canvassing, phone banking, friend banking, and more! | Paid for by Michaela for Tennessee Michaela for TennesseePO Box 9116Knoxville, TN 37940United States "Website"

**I got into this race because like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes and tired of perpetually playing defense. **

I won this primary because I played offense, and **I’m going to run a relentless full-court press to win this seat in November.**

I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your support alone, will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than a decade and take back the Senate Majority.

Look, I’m under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge – physically, mentally, financially.

But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson.

**This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now. **

clean_body: | = I’m Josh Turek. I’m a Democratic state legislator who won a deep red seat, four-time Paralympian, and two-time gold medalist in wheelchair basketball. I thought the feeling of winning my first gold medal at the 2016 Rio Paralympics would only come once in a lifetime. But, the race was just called: I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Iowa’s open U.S. Senate seat. Grassroots energy usually peaks in the first few days after a primary, so we have to get down to business ASAP. = | | = I’m honored that the people of Iowa have put their faith in me, and I’m ready to take this once-in-a-generation shot to win this OPEN seat and be the champion working people deserve in Washington. I got into this race because like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes and tired of perpetually playing defense. I won this primary because I played offense, and I’m going to run a relentless full-court press to win this seat in November. I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your support alone, will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than a decade and take back the Senate Majority. = | = Look, I’m under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially. But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson. This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now. We have 153 days to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the future. Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost primary victory. ## Something important is happening among women across America.
---
| Mothers are asking deeper questions. Families are searching for stronger foundations. Women are looking for wisdom, clarity, encouragement, and honest conversation in a culture that often feels loud, divided, and disconnected. That is why a new season of The Mom View is launching — and why so many women are tuning in each week. Now filmed in a beautiful new studio at the [Herzog Foundation](https://momsforamerica.us/so/a7Pw5lJor/c?w=FipoMV_CDZTXO1M-Qaaqzb257s07nTR2OtRAhDPzPo8.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZXJ6b2dmb3VuZGF0aW9uLmNvbS8iLCJyIjoiIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiYjM4MzhiZjgtZmFiMC00MWI5LTk2NzMtZThjNmJlZmI2NTc3In0) in Missouri and recently syndicated on [Total Living Network (TLN)](https://momsforamerica.us/so/a7Pw5lJor/c?w=GWLTHrcKXGGjod918Lsq92wgNEtdwgabXO1srhaLmUw.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGxubWVkaWEuY29tLyIsInIiOiIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ). [The Mom View](https://momsforamerica.us/so/a7Pw5lJor/c?w=J85c-Dlc12N12hwxwL_kJQVf-cPGxTb0Nd-U1HjvOzA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly90aGVtb212aWV3LmNvbS8iLCJyIjoiIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiYjM4MzhiZjgtZmFiMC00MWI5LTk2NzMtZThjNmJlZmI2NTc3In0) is growing into a national conversation centered on faith, family, motherhood, leadership, culture, and the issues shaping the future of America. This season also welcomes new host Vanessa Faura alongside Kimberly Fletcher and Debbie Kraulidis. Together, they bring a thoughtful perspective and meaningful discussion to conversations that matter to today’s women and families. But The Mom View is more than headlines and politics. It is a place where women can hear real conversations about raising children in today’s world, protecting family values, building strong homes, navigating culture with wisdom, and staying grounded in faith during uncertain times.

body:
The GOP Primary is June 9th | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/votemarksmith/gr-update-june3?e=d4051626af)
---
| | |
---
| | | |
# EARLY VOTING
---
| Friends, The moment we've been working toward for the last 300 days is finally here. **Early voting is now underway across South Carolina's First Congressional District. In just 6 days, voters will head to the polls to vote!** [Find your early voting location by clicking here.](https://us.list-manage.com/tAVT64FpH3Q?e=d4051626af&c2id=abc2b72b7650387dd48df8e6f8a4729e) If you've been waiting to cast your ballot, now is the time. Every vote matters, and every conversation we've had throughout this campaign has led to this moment. Whether you've attended an event, hosted a meet-and-greet, put up a yard sign, said a prayer, or simply encouraged a friend to get involved, thank you. This campaign belongs to all of us. If you haven't voted yet, please make a plan today and encourage your friends and family to do the same. **And don't forget to vote June 9th in the Republican Primary!**
---
| |
# 700 EVENTS. 300 DAYS.
---
| When we launched this campaign in August of 2025, I made a simple promise: I would show up. I would travel every corner of the Lowcountry, listen to the concerns of hardworking families, and earn your trust face-to-face. By the time voters head to the polls on June 9th, #TeamMarkSmith will have attended **more than 700 events in just 300 days** across South Carolina's First Congressional District. From community festivals and Republican clubs to church events, small businesses, veterans groups, and neighborhood gatherings, we've taken our message directly to the people.
---
| |
# CONSERVATIVE PROMISES
---
| I'm also proud to share several important milestones from the past week: ✅ Signed the **Americans for Tax Reform Taxpayer Protection Pledge** ✅ Endorsed by **America First Insights** ✅ Endorsed by the **National Rifle Association** These endorsements reflect the same conservative principles I've fought for in the State House: lower taxes, protecting our constitutional rights, securing the border, supporting law enforcement, and standing up for South Carolina values.
---
| |
# WATCH OUR NEW TV AD
---
| As we enter the final days of this campaign, we've launched a new television commercial highlighting my record, my roots, and my commitment to the Lowcountry. As a fourth-generation Lowcountry native, small business owner, husband, father, and State Representative, I've spent my life working to make our communities stronger. I hope you'll take a moment to watch it and share it with friends and family. **WATCH THE AD >>**
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/gPp40Be72s6?e=d4051626af&c2id=abc2b72b7650387dd48df8e6f8a4729e)
---
We're focused on keeping the Lowcountry First, fixing our roads, and making life more affordable.
| |
# SHOW YOUR SUPPORT
---
| Help us spread the word during these final days by sharing the graphic below on social media. 🇺🇸 **I'M VOTING FOR MARK SMITH** ✔️ Proven Conservative
✔️ Gets Results
✔️ Stands with President Trump
✔️ Fighting for South Carolina Values Use this graphic as your profile picture, share it on Facebook, post it on X, or text it to friends and family. Every share helps us reach another voter.
---
|
---
| |
# HOW TO VOTE
---
| **Early voting begins Tuesday, May 26th, and we’ve updated our website with information on:**
* Early voting locations
* Voting dates and times
* How to find your polling place
* Military and overseas voting information

[Please take a moment to make your voting plan today and share it with your family and friends.](https://us.list-manage.com/68sTdNBtacn?e=d4051626af&c2id=abc2b72b7650387dd48df8e6f8a4729e)
---
| |
# HELP OUR CAMPAIGN
---
| Finally, if you’re able, I’m asking you to consider making a contribution to help us keep this momentum growing. Every donation helps us continue reaching voters across the Lowcountry through mail, digital outreach, texting, events, and our grassroots field operation.
---
| [DONATE TODAY](https://us.list-manage.com/vzF4cjLFyCw?e=d4051626af&c2id=abc2b72b7650387dd48df8e6f8a4729e "DONATE TODAY")
---
| **Thank you again for believing in this campaign and for believing in the future of the Lowcountry.** I’m grateful for every endorsement and every small victory, but campaigns are ultimately won by people willing to step up, spread the word, and vote. That’s how we win — together. With appreciation,

State Rep. Mark Smith
Republican for Congress

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

body:

| | |
---
| | | | [|

| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEJune 3, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**SENATORS BLACKBURN, ERNST, AND HYDE-SMITH ENDORSE LETLOW FOR U.S. SENATE** _Conservative senators back Trump-endorsed Julia Letlow for U.S. Senate in Louisiana_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for United States Senate in Louisiana, announced today the endorsements of U.S. Senators Marsha Blackburn, Joni Ernst, and Cindy Hyde-Smith, adding to the growing list of conservative leaders rallying behind her campaign.
_“Julia Letlow is a strong conservative woman who understands the importance of faith, family, and fighting for the values that make this country great,”_**said Senator Blackburn.**_“Julia will be a fearless ally for President Trump and a tremendous addition to the Senate, and I’m thrilled to endorse her.”_
_“Julia Letlow understands that agriculture is the backbone of states like Louisiana and Iowa,”_**said Senator Ernst.**_**** “She will stand with President Trump to fight for our farmers, protect rural communities, and push back on the radical left’s policies driving up costs for producers and families. I'm proud to endorse Julia Letlow for the United States Senate.”_
_“Julia Letlow is a proven conservative leader who will always put Louisiana families and American values first,”_**said Senator Hyde-Smith.**_“She understands the importance of keeping our communities safe, defending our freedoms, supporting law enforcement, and standing with President Trump. I’m proud to endorse Julia Letlow for Senate and look forward to serving with her.”_
_“I’m incredibly grateful to have the support of Senators Blackburn, Ernst, and Hyde-Smith,”_**said Congresswoman Letlow.**_“These are strong conservative women who have been fearless leaders in the Senate and trusted allies of President Trump. I look forward to working alongside them to fight for Louisiana families, defend our conservative values, and help advance the America First agenda in the United States Senate.”_
These endorsements come after Letlow has received endorsements nationwide from conservative leaders including U.S. Senators Rick Scott, Katie Britt, Jim Banks, Bernie Moreno, and Tim Sheehy.
President Trump endorsed Letlow’s campaign earlier this year, calling her a strong conservative who will always stand with the America First movement.

[1]Justice Democrats

BREAKING news, Peter:

Justice Democrat Dr. Adam Hamawy beat the political machine and won the
Democratic primary for New Jersey’s 12th congressional district!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260603-1.QUlT92&refcode=em20260603-37858&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37858%2E1203867%2EQ1gFIJ ]Congratulations NJ-12 primary 2026 winner Justice Democrat Adam Hamawy

Dr. Hamawy, a veteran and surgeon who volunteered in Gaza, defeated 12
other candidates in this crowded primary by a landslide!

His victory — Justice Democrats’ third win of the 2026 cycle — was made
possible by this grassroots movement, despite an eleventh-hour attempt
from the establishment to boost one of his opponents with $400,000 in
mysterious Super PAC support.

Dr. Hamawy won this race the old-fashioned way: by outworking his
opponents, out-organizing the establishment, and building the progressive
coalition needed to deliver his people-first vision to New Jersey working
families.

He centered his experience as a veteran and surgeon to expose the
for-profit agenda behind America’s healthcare system and war machine, and
ran on a clear vision for Medicare for All and making life more affordable
for everyday people — not corporate lobbies and war profiteers.

AIPAC, Crypto, and AI wanted to buy this seat and were interviewing
various candidates, but while they couldn’t choose which corporate shill
to back, the left united behind a political outsider with a vision that
spoke to the needs and priorities of Jersey voters.

AIPAC’s cycle so far in New Jersey is the perfect representation of how
much they flounder and fail against an electorate who simply knows who
they are and therefore, knows better.

We can’t wait for Dr. Adam to join our progressive bloc in Congress as the
first Justice Democrat to represent New Jersey. Now, we have six more
primaries left, and New York is up next on June 23.

AIPAC and the corporate-backed Democratic establishment: pitch in
$5 now to help us send another six Justice Democrats to
Washington this cycle!

Peter, here’s what I need you to know:
**First polls showed us neck-and-neck with my opponent John Sununu.** This race is in a virtual tie.
**Then a right-wing super PAC made the largest ad reservation in New Hampshire in a _decade_** – to the tune of $17 million.
**Now my campaign manager just told me we’re being outspent by another GOP super PAC backing Sununu.** In a race as competitive as this one, we can’t afford to lose an inch.
I don’t take money from corporate PACs, so I am relying on this grassroots team to win. That’s why I’m asking:
**[Peter, will you split $5 between our campaign and Roy Cooper today? We’ll put it right to work to keep New Hampshire blue and help Democrats flip the Senate. Every single donation counts in a race this close.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/12856?amount=5&t=7&akid=1631%2E124072%2E2X78aU)**

I can't thank you enough.
I am beyond grateful for your support. It is the fuel that keeps our campaign moving.

Susan Collins

# **We Are CASA Joins the Fight Against Flock in Roanoke**
---
ROANOKE, VIRGINIA - _We Are CASA_ released a statement calling for opposition against the use and expansion of "Flock Safety equipment" in Roanoke City. This call to action joins the effort led by Delegate Sam Rasoul (HB-38) to end the use and expansion of Flock technology across Roanoke City. "People should be able to live their lives without feeling like they are constantly being watched, tracked, or recorded," **said Luis Aguilar, Director of _We Are CASA Virginia_ , in the organization's statement**. "Where we drive, where we gather, and what we say should not be monitored without clear justification and strong safeguards. This proposal is an attack on the freedoms and liberties that belong to all of us. We can keep our communities safe without expanding surveillance that puts our privacy and trust at risk." "I am grateful that this issue is remaining in the forefront," **said Delegate Sam Rasoul.** "The expansion of surveillance technology is a direct attack on the right we all have under the 4th Amendment of our Constitution. By expanding the use and expansion of Flock across Roanoke City, we are putting everyone's rights at risk." [Del. body:

| James O'Keefe | | | Arrested. Raided. Betrayed. Sued. Still standing. | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEDySgDLbsrOQ_5gy2EQhz61yaN0qI1SBx-Z6uCkcTGcg2zYUp4GJ3BtoK_knGtiiNbeiO5-llZcrXYfXOFohYI1KZ2ir5f2TsD)
---
[ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEETXQaCa9dvsE_JePiqrsKA1Gn-tLxeoyxOXyPkV_t0uYAbHn2xXANSb1P6sA7j4-MIdg7pb7uX6VbahUU4PfZAiIFfgEDMs4b "https://secure.anedot.com/okeefemediagroup/omg-cannot-be-beaten-mb?utm_source=omg-cannot-be-beaten&utm_medium=tld&utm_campaign=mb&amount=35")Dear Friend,

I posted a picture of myself this weekend. Buzzed head. Arms crossed. No smile.

A friend of mine looked at it and said, "You don't even look like the same person."

He's right. I'm not.

I'm 41 years old. I've been doing this work for twenty-two years. And every single one of those years left a mark -- not on my face, but on my spine. On my will. On the thing inside me that refuses to quit.

They tried to destroy me. They arrested me. They raided my home. They sued me. They conspired against me from the inside. They sent a former board member to the FBI to feed them information and try to put me in prison.

And I'm still here.

Not just still here. Stronger than I've ever been. And I need you to understand why -- because your [**support right now is what keeps me in the fight**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEF0sdsqBW3MUXpPat3JJNhI3tbSyVAMDCJn-MiRKI4HzxZDV2RBXEkcOWxa8wMXGbotl8PaXgM4WnOPNOz-4g7nNkOjOjRrfbk). ****[STAND WITH JAMES-- DONATE NOW](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEGw3_zv51uw_v2hEhP-LYeDjskbydk97zynBuKti544MkUf1t34RDd0amy2n5mJBMLnn6AW1p6VVZqezvj_ha5lsbL326D8pzA)**** Let me take you back to January 2010. I was twenty-five years old. A kid with a camera and a conviction that the truth mattered more than my comfort.

Federal agents put me in handcuffs inside a United States senator's office in New Orleans. They led me out in front of the cameras. Every network in the country ran the footage. "Conservative activist arrested," the chyrons said. They wanted that to be the end of my story.

I was twenty-five. I had no money. No legal team. No powerful friends. Just a belief that citizens had a right to know what their government was doing -- and a willingness to pay the price for acting on it.

That false arrest was supposed to scare me into silence. It did the opposite. It taught me that the people in power will use every weapon they have against anyone who threatens the narrative. And it taught me that I could take the hit and keep walking. ****[KEEP JAMES AND OMG IN THE FIGHT-- DONATE NOW](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEH7OtwUg5BTv8xXajm-6223dnpBiUYOZDxMnyH2Ti8mcKgIhUyxSKUQpkIQSQKAe9k0F-3K40vew4XMdltr6dyg7aByz_7zt0M)**** Eleven years later, they came for me again. This time they didn't just arrest me. They kicked in my door.

November 2021. FBI agents swarmed my apartment in New York. They put me in handcuffs in my own hallway. They seized my phones. They rifled through my belongings. A journalist -- treated like a criminal in his own home.

Why? Because someone gave us a diary that belonged to the President's daughter. We didn't publish it. We turned it over to law enforcement. **And they raided me anyway**.

Think about that. We did the right thing -- and the FBI showed up at my door at dawn with guns and handcuffs.

The message was clear: We don't care what you did or didn't publish. We want you to know that we can reach you. Anywhere. Anytime.

**[**Can you chip in $35, $50, or $100 right now to help me keep fighting?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEI5pjI9S-b-Lr4JeNbqlfDubR3KQE1LWc5D8Zeoz16-VrwFb0FaM43wFFLXGaJ3bAgz56iyVDh_EofKjurtttRG_aoP_CVOD0L)**

The raids and the arrests -- those I expected. What I didn't expect was the betrayal from inside.

A man who sat on my own board -- a man I trusted -- went to the FBI and became an informant against me. He admitted it on our hidden cameras. He told our undercover journalist he'd fed "tons of information" to federal law enforcement. Every agency that called, he answered.

Then we found his copy of my book, Breakthrough -- with a rifle bullet fired straight through the heart on the cover. Exit wound out the back. When I confronted him in Miami Beach and asked him about it, he said: "I needed a target."

When I asked if he'd kill me, he called it "a figure of speech."

A figure of speech. A bullet through my heart. From a man who was supposed to protect the organization I built. ****[BACK JAMES AND OMG-- DONATE NOW](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEJgzpr-xSkvhjlbgk_9G20CizEGs8F5fBoTk6-sWtCQn9DxsZ0xvYsKMB0rhdS9ClCEJ1JjmiX2m3y3pHqiCQ5ba8JuEa7IbS2)**** I could fill a filing cabinet with the lawsuits they've thrown at me. Pentagon contractors. DOJ officials. Corporate executives. My own former organization sued me after I was forced out by the very board that harbored an FBI informant.

Every lawsuit is designed to do the same thing: bleed me dry. Tie me up in discovery. Drain the resources I need for investigations and redirect them to lawyers. That's how lawfare works -- you don't have to win in court. You just have to make the fight so expensive that your target gives up.

They've been waiting sixteen years for me to give up.

I haven't.

**[**Help me keep going**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEKsYTj17TTayxqOczlsZgcaEwGnUOCabvCPxGTSwT2NsSZncTvUV9yNPM6QAmaL9yXiXjY2q0CnVY-HgfHtyFUUw8CmGgq1Abp). $35 helps cover a day of fieldwork. $100 funds legal review on an investigation. $250 helps launch the next undercover operation.**

I want to be honest with you about something, because I think you deserve it.

I don't have a normal life. I can't. The opposition is always watching. Always looking for a way to set me up, take me down, catch me in something they can twist into a headline. I've accepted that. There's no turning it off. There's no weekend where I stop being James O'Keefe.

So I channel everything into the work. Into the training. Into the mission. The kid they arrested in Louisiana is gone. In his place is something their attacks created -- a man who has been hit so many times that he's stopped flinching. A man who walks into Antifa headquarters in disguise with hidden cameras rolling. A man who flies to Miami Beach to confront the traitor who shot a bullet through his book. A man who goes back to Minneapolis after receiving a death threat.

**They wanted to break me. Instead, they built something they can 't beat.**

And the results speak for themselves. This year alone, OMG investigations have triggered $253 million in federal contracts being suspended. We forced the Secret Service to suspend an agent who was leaking the Vice President's security details. We've recorded seven FBI and DOJ officials on hidden camera admitting the system is broken. We've generated millions of views -- not because we write opinion columns, but because we show up with cameras where nobody else will.

That's what your donation buys. Not talk. Results.

[**I 'm asking you to stand with me today**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbELAEk_5xaM1dwjOV4OHYO6JwScp9x9hyLp2URdqHPLRI4Qkjegf9_VA0ZVslYmuaLD3aZR5pQF15GbBD4747L9Lj1EiWjnhQpE). Not because I need sympathy -- I don't. [**I need resources.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEMxwwOQXHKpFcyNUG7fJISYB3KVtH_GO6sd0_66sLmAIOV8yv57mEHZzBS-CKQ8wwSGYaKdO124DZ_lMwP-afZkoyxGIObJMkH)

**[**$35 covers a background check**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbENr9seHdvzU9aJShcALhrUtzGDOIP5gqm95D0r6eqQun-gMeW6lrMbjBs7IRzFlOBhoiV7gMJX1_Sg3v0NjHF33f3wV2RrqbrK)** before we send someone undercover.

**[**$50 helps pay for encrypted equipment**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEOLIqMHey9OOELgkUvD5Jn9qMtUnRLtIujT_1q5dn5PmTMHeZ1ZvysCDVw0XSCA-lsaFfeK1R6X0t73fB1XGkaxeHy35IcU0WJ)** that keeps our journalists safe.

**[**$100 funds the legal review**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEPKCiHTXKLr7470u_Bjd2thFTrtTxoR02jYnBK5CIumHJgn9mAc2gkTV79M9UxKkvb5aSDKIi3iTJLgFz7H3ngBYJEgoj_4Q4l)** that lets us publish what the powerful want buried.

**[**$250 helps us launch the next investigation --**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEQpKvQHd0VXK6UYL7cO947B5YULnbN7odONsqYKYVfOEDjektHtuVXo973uGRtoEZ0x4kkWBPzd38eZpW0kpRnV-pIbS4VC2qR)** because we have more targets than budget.

**[**$500 or more funds a full day of protected field operations.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbERFMH7NYx4ZIoZStATiDSIT-nwdpwR0b743vTJObBkT7nUcg5NqjW8CEAd-B7s0h0jNMckPMHrwtxFXMxsO5gipX_P1ZZYKD7k)**

They arrested me at twenty-five. They raided me at thirty-seven. They betrayed me from the inside. They sued me from every direction. And here I am at forty-one -- still standing, still fighting, and stronger than I've ever been.

**The only question is whether you 're standing with me.**

Rush your best gift right now -- [**$35, $50, $100, or whatever you can**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbESPo-tSqBDWq02Voy7taSQtoQ92OW3jM0zI203Y9atZlWw7_wXCIr-dm3ftZXczy_rMNXvpaZd_jdKEEpNDSOI8K0WugS-BXt8). Thank you for being part of something they can't stop.

In Truth, James O'Keefe Founder and CEO O'Keefe Media Group

**P.S.** Sixteen years ago they put me in handcuffs and thought that would be the end of it. Then they raided my home. Then they turned a board member into an informant. Then they sued me from every angle. And every single time, I got back up. I'm not going anywhere. But I need you in this fight. [**Donate today -- any amount -- and stand with the man they couldn't break.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbETc8X1TtO1qT5dKcEfvT7gUYlr2Z6YS1nDPZo_grvcMJEZ6Nx_gBqpzJgalE-v_TMNzzSZYXbvGFqcw-EzWcrVBiR5tQub2hij)
[STAND WITH OMG NOW](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ4OTZ9AAwAAAAAAP3bIbEUctJ6-Qqtigih9Qao8ccf2-u2EwWJIJ-E0cyvpajQuU34Ub_uWtI0dYUjjAagfpss5T-x-lyWFqo20vkSrcIbEyEjceoI-O4e)

Corporate executives. My own former organization sued me after I was forced out by the very board that harbored an FBI informant. Every lawsuit is designed to do the same thing: bleed me dry. Tie me up in discovery. Drain the resources I need for investigations and redirect them to lawyers. That's how lawfare works -- you don't have to win in court. You just have to make the fight so expensive that your target gives up. They've been waiting sixteen years for me to give up. I haven't. . $35 helps cover a day of fieldwork. $100 funds legal review on an investigation. $250 helps launch the next undercover operation. I want to be honest with you about something, because I think you deserve it. I don't have a normal life. I can't. The opposition is always watching. Always looking for a way to set me up, take me down, catch me in something they can twist into a headline. I've accepted that. There's no turning it off. There's no weekend where I stop being James O'Keefe. So I channel everything into the work. Into the training. Into the mission. The kid they arrested in Louisiana is gone. In his place is something their attacks created -- a man who has been hit so many times that he's stopped flinching. A man who walks into Antifa headquarters in disguise with hidden cameras rolling. A man who flies to Miami Beach to confront the traitor who shot a bullet through his book. A man who goes back to Minneapolis after receiving a death threat. They wanted to break me. Instead, they built something they can 't beat. And the results speak for themselves. This year alone, OMG investigations have triggered $253 million in federal contracts being suspended. We forced the Secret Service to suspend an agent who was leaking the Vice President's security details. We've recorded seven FBI and DOJ officials on hidden camera admitting the system is broken. We've generated millions of views -- not because we write opinion columns, but because we show up with cameras where nobody else will. That's what your donation buys. Not talk. Results. . Not because I need sympathy -- I don't. before we send someone undercover. that keeps our journalists safe. that lets us publish what the powerful want buried. because we have more targets than budget. They arrested me at twenty-five. They raided me at thirty-seven. They betrayed me from the inside. They sued me from every direction. And here I am at forty-one -- still standing, still fighting, and stronger than I've ever been. The only question is whether you 're standing with me. Rush your best gift right now -- . Thank you for being part of something they can't stop. In Truth, James O'Keefe Founder and CEO O'Keefe Media Group P.S. Sixteen years ago they put me in handcuffs and thought that would be the end of it. Then they raided my home. Then they turned a board member into an informant. Then they sued me from every angle. And every single time, I got back up. I'm not going anywhere. But I need you in this fight.

I’m Josh Turek. I’m a Democratic state legislator who won a deep red seat,
a four-time Paralympian, and two-time gold medalist in wheelchair
basketball.

I thought the feeling of winning my first gold medal at the 2016 Rio
Paralympics would only come once in a lifetime. But the race was just
called:

I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Iowa’s open U.S. Senate seat.

Derek, grassroots energy usually peaks in the first few days
after a primary, so we have to get down to business ASAP. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_turek.olX6ap&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260603_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=9841%2E5257348%2E3ws4DR ]Will you help
me make the most of our hard-fought victory by splitting a donation
between my campaign and Adam Schiff to become one of the first Founding
Donors of my General Election campaign?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_turek.olX6ap&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260603_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=9841%2E5257348%2E3ws4DR ]Split a donation!

I’m honored that the people of Iowa have put their faith in me, and I’m
ready to take this once-in-a-generation shot to win this OPEN seat and be
the champion working people deserve in Washington.

I got into this race because, like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed
up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes, and
tired of perpetually playing defense.

I won this primary because I played offense, and I’m going to run a
relentless full-court press to win this seat in November.

I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your
support alone, will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than
a decade and take back the Senate Majority.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_turek.olX6ap&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260603_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=9841%2E5257348%2E3ws4DR ]I’m personally asking you to become one of our first General Election
Founding Donors by splitting a contribution of $15, $20, $35, or more
today. Your contribution will power my voter outreach so I can flip Joni
Ernst’s Senate seat and restore hope and faith in the great state of Iowa.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_turek.olX6ap&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260603_AM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=9841%2E5257348%2E3ws4DR ]Split a donation!

a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst,
Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast
of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially.

But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back
victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one
point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson.

This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now.

We have 153 days to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie
Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA
megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the
future.

Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and
our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost
primary victory.

The outcome of this race will decide the Senate majority with huge
implications for our country, so my team and I need every single solitary
ounce of support to hit the ground rolling. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=abs_em_turek.olX6ap&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260603_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=9841%2E5257348%2E3ws4DR ]Will you rush a split

[ ]Will you help me make the most of our hard-fought victory by splitting a donation between my campaign and Adam Schiff to become one of the first Founding Donors of my General Election campaign? [ ]Split a donation! I’m honored that the people of Iowa have put their faith in me, and I’m ready to take this once-in-a-generation shot to win this OPEN seat and be the champion working people deserve in Washington. I got into this race because, like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes, and tired of perpetually playing defense. I won this primary because I played offense, and I’m going to run a relentless full-court press to win this seat in November. I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your support alone, will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than a decade and take back the Senate Majority. [ ]I’m personally asking you to become one of our first General Election Founding Donors by splitting a contribution of $15, $20, $35, or more today. Your contribution will power my voter outreach so I can flip Joni Ernst’s Senate seat and restore hope and faith in the great state of Iowa. [ ]Split a donation! Derek, I’m under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially. But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson. This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now. We have 153 days to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the future. Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost primary victory. The outcome of this race will decide the Senate majority with huge implications for our country, so my team and I need every single solitary ounce of support to hit the ground rolling. name: Katie Porter
subject: I am so incredibly proud of the campaign that we built together
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41476%2E3422442%2EGsTvxI)
Friends,
As I look back on this race, I am so incredibly proud of the campaign that we built. Together, we talked about the issues that were important to California, particularly affordability and bringing down costs, including making housing the top issue in our campaign because it's the top expense for most California families.
Our campaign was unique — not just as the most successful campaign of a Democratic woman running for California governor this century — but because we were the only candidate to not take a dime of corporate money. We spoke truth to power, stood up to Donald Trump, and fought for a California where every person can thrive. That wouldn’t have been possible without the hundreds of thousands of you who chipped in, volunteered your time, and supported this campaign.
I want to say thank you: to my team for their tireless work fighting for a better California, to the families that opened up their homes for me to come talk to their friends and neighbors, to the businesses who welcomed me and taught me more about their industry, to the organizations that shared their challenges and hopes for our state, and to the Californians who supported and voted for me along the way.
Now, our attention must be on November, when we will elect a Democrat as our next Governor and Democrats up and down the ticket. This election is our chance to put a check on Donald Trump’s abuses of power and the path to flipping the House runs directly through California.
Running in a race like this isn't easy, and coming up short is hard. But democracy is worth doing hard things for. Stay in the fight, stay engaged, and thank you for believing in me.
Yours Truly,
Katie Porter

* [**00:09:29**] We talk about why standing up to intimidation matters--and why compliance only encourages more abuse of power.
* [**00:15:00**] A deep dive into Viktor Orban's Hungary, what "illiberal democracy" looks like in practice, and why those warning signs matter here at home.

| | Friends,
I was recently asked whether I would be willing to work with Republican attorneys general from across the country on a new task force focused on cracking down on rampant welfare fraud. My answer is simple: absolutely.
As a prosecutor, I have spent decades fighting fraud and holding criminals accountable. In 2003, I began leading the [Eaton County Economic Crimes Unit](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001GKrc_o3bXeAlGikXZywqKfONvTRL6YRioZYF_If3wUms8qTRI4-e11leTHg_SPKoHp99M-w0i4r4kb75dvA8-EHwuSUQfZc8icVYK86g6mn10AhEgkkLsnkwLXD5DlHenb3y8GFeE-tUiuJ8A-rFvyXqT6f7kXauK6UxnpUJnSm-ab9Ht6dgMGE1w9tDLYgR&c=JZBNoKM5nbtzk8Wu8e9A4cChxzG0o-YquyAAIIDEQWRba1ZWbH3KXg==&ch=37CN2RXb-_5LnAEUPImo5DBNfn7b5RKyjA4C2JWxhRKY5S4yohWq4A==), which prosecutes welfare fraud and other financial crimes across Eaton, Clinton, and Ingham counties. For more than a decade, I also handled check fraud prosecutions on behalf of the Secretary of State. Investigating and prosecuting fraud, embezzlement, and financial crimes has been a major focus throughout my career, and I am ready to bring that experience to the Attorney General's Office.
I have also built strong relationships with attorneys general across the country. The Republican Attorneys General Association has made Michigan one of its top priorities this cycle, and I have developed strong connections with leaders who are committed to restoring law and order and protecting taxpayers.
With more than three decades of prosecutorial experience, proven leadership, and strong partnerships already in place, I am prepared to aggressively investigate and prosecute the fraud that has become far too common in our state.
This campaign continues to build momentum because Michiganders are ready for an attorney general who is willing and able to do the job. Thank you for your support. Together, we will win in November.

clean_body: A proven record of prosecuting financial crimes. | | | | | == | | | == | | Friends, I was recently asked whether I would be willing to work with Republican attorneys general from across the country on a new task force focused on cracking down on rampant welfare fraud. My answer is simple: absolutely. As a prosecutor, I have spent decades fighting fraud and holding criminals accountable. In 2003, I began leading the ==, which prosecutes welfare fraud and other financial crimes across Eaton, Clinton, and Ingham counties. For more than a decade, I also handled check fraud prosecutions on behalf of the Secretary of State. Investigating and prosecuting fraud, embezzlement, and financial crimes has been a major focus throughout my career, and I am ready to bring that experience to the Attorney General's Office. I have also built strong relationships with attorneys general across the country. The Republican Attorneys General Association has made Michigan one of its top priorities this cycle, and I have developed strong connections with leaders who are committed to restoring law and order and protecting taxpayers. With more than three decades of prosecutorial experience, proven leadership, and strong partnerships already in place, I am prepared to aggressively investigate and prosecute the fraud that has become far too common in our state. This campaign continues to build momentum because Michiganders are ready for an attorney general who is willing and able to do the job. Thank you for your support. Together, we will win in November. These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. I became a scientist because I believe facts matter.
I believe public health decisions should be guided by evidence, research, and the goal of saving lives — not conspiracy theories or political ideology.
That’s why the latest news about Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is so alarming.
He is blocking hundreds of millions of dollars in vaccine funding for vulnerable children around the world because of his personal beliefs about vaccines and a preservative that study after study has found to be safe.

And yet RFK Jr. keeps pushing the same debunked anti-vaccine theories that scientists and doctors have repeatedly disproven.
This is what happens when politicians ignore science: Children’s lives become bargaining chips, preventable diseases spread, and public trust is eroded by extremists trying to replace evidence with ideology.

Wade , and they've only escalated in the past year. If you feel like it’s been impossible to stay informed on every new development, you are not alone. That's why our speakers will be breaking down all the most urgent threats to abortion access and sharing updates on the Center's ongoing fight in the courts to defend reproductive care. We'll also be sharing information on what you can do to stay in this fight and protect abortion access in your state. We sincerely hope to see you there tomorrow. This pro-democracy movement is rising up to meet a pivotal moment.
Across the South, lawmakers are rushing to draw new voting maps that silence Black and brown voters.
But across the South, with solidarity from all over the country, we are fighting back.
**We’re reaching out to voters in key states so they can call on their lawmakers to reject new gerrymanders.**
With this team’s support, we’ve made 20,000+ contacts in Alabama, 99,000+ contacts in Louisiana, 132,000+ contacts in Mississippi, 58,000+ contacts in Tennessee, and 312,000+ contacts here in Georgia, where a special map-rigging session starts in just a few weeks.
[**When we see a rise in donations to emails like this one, we’re able to expand our outreach and bring even more people into the fight. Make a 2X-matched contribution, and go twice as far to fight for fair elections with fair maps.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132636727/625181720/-221721003?refcode=emm_ffa_20260603_T1_MatchExtension_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YTY4MmM3MC02YjVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rIOfwbctFI42FJb7AjCirpw-QQkrLy8CMLmnSANasRA=)
Recently, our co-founder, Stacey Abrams, testified before the Tennessee Senate Judiciary Committee and laid bare the stakes of this moment:
_“I come before you today though as a daughter of the South... because we are yoked together by geography and destiny. I did not travel to Tennessee today to weigh in on a policy debate or a political fight._
_“The question before you is whether America will continue the long, unfinished work of building a multi-racial, multi-ethnic, multi-generational democracy that belongs to all of us — or whether we will tear down the very protections that made that democracy finally possible.” —Stacey Abrams_
Our team also traveled to Montgomery, Alabama to rally for the National Day of Action on Voting Rights. Thousands joined from around the country to say “Hands off our votes.”
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132636728/625181721/-221721003?refcode=emm_ffa_20260603_T1_MatchExtension_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YTY4MmM3MC02YjVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rIOfwbctFI42FJb7AjCirpw-QQkrLy8CMLmnSANasRA=)
That weekend, a powerful demonstration on the Edmund Pettus Bridge evoked the freedom fighters from 1965 who marched and bled for the Voting Rights Act.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132636729/625181722/-221721003?refcode=emm_ffa_20260603_T1_MatchExtension_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YTY4MmM3MC02YjVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=rIOfwbctFI42FJb7AjCirpw-QQkrLy8CMLmnSANasRA=)
And all over America, grassroots donors are pitching in to power our ongoing fight for the freedom to vote in fair elections.
[**This 2X match opportunity only exists because we’re in a critical moment where we need as much grassroots support as possible. We’ve got to keep up the fight. Senator Ossoff has a moral conscience, and he can bring together a broad coalition to make things better for hardworking Georgians and Americans.
[**Let’s make sure Jon Ossoff can continue to stand up for hardworking Georgians and Americans in the U.S. Senate.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-king.MONPQZ&refcode=em260603-1-f-nl&t=10&akid=2341%2E5691347%2ERNS06D)

Peter, thank you so much for participating. Stay strong. We’ll get through this.
My best wishes to you and your family,
-Carole

[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Happy Pride Month! 🌈

I’m looking forward to celebrating with Michiganders at Pride events
across the state this month and recognizing the joy, strength, and
community that Pride represents.

Pride is a celebration, but it’s also a reminder that the fight for
equality and dignity for LGBTQ+ people continues every single day.

At a time when LGBTQ+ communities across the country are facing hateful
attacks from politicians trying to score political points, I want to be
very clear: as governor, I will always stand up for the rights, safety,
and dignity of LGBTQ+ Michiganders.

Because everyone deserves to feel safe in their community. Everyone
deserves equal rights and equal protection under the law. And every young
person deserves to grow up knowing they belong exactly as they are.

That’s the kind of Michigan I believe in, and it’s the kind of Michigan
I’m fighting for every day in this campaign.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/6096?t=1001&akid=1670%2E181023%2Edm7dKu ]So during Pride Month, I wanted to ask: If you believe in building a
Michigan that is welcoming, inclusive, and protects the rights of every
person, will you chip in a few dollars to support my campaign for governor
today?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your

Alexandria’s primary election is less than three weeks away.! Will you join us in this final stretch by contacting voters?
#
Alexandria’s primary election is less than three weeks away! Will you join us in this final stretch by contacting voters?
You can volunteer to support Alexandria’s re-election no matter where you’re located! All you need is a computer and solid internet connection.
**[Will you sign up to phonebank to reach voters in NY-14 and make sure they have everything they need to vote in the upcoming primary election?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/36669?utm_source=em20260603-11591&t=4&akid=11591%2E2526796%2ECxcgIp)**
**[Sign Up](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/36669?utm_source=em20260603-11591&t=5&akid=11591%2E2526796%2ECxcgIp)**
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/36669?utm_source=em20260603-11591&t=6&akid=11591%2E2526796%2ECxcgIp)
We’ll call residents of NY-14 to talk to them about Alexandria, the election, and the issues that matter to us — healthcare, housing, climate justice, and more!
Never phonebanked before? No worries! We always start with a training, go over our call script, and review best practices. Our expert team members will be available to support you throughout the phonebanking session as well.
Let's get this done and turn out voters all throughout NY-14!
In solidarity,
Team AOC

Fellow Patriot, it’s Rob O’Neill, a Navy SEAL and proud American.

I was part of the heroic team that put Osama bin Laden in a body bag. Our pilots, aircrew, intel, QRF, and air support put it all on the line to accomplish the mission.

I've spent a lot of time lately thinking about what makes someone genuinely effective in public office. And one of the things I keep coming back to is rootedness – whether a person actually knows the place they're fighting for, how they've been shaped by it, how people there trust them because they've earned it over time. That's not something you can manufacture. You either have it or you don't. Janelle Bynum has it. She represents Oregon's 5th District, and in 2024 she flipped it from red to blue – one of the only Democrats to do so that cycle – becoming the first Black person to represent Oregon in the U.S. House. That kind of win doesn't come from nowhere. It comes from a candidate who genuinely knows her community and has spent years showing up for it. Since taking office, she's governed the same way. She's held more than two dozen in-person town halls, because she believes her job is to listen as much as it is to legislate. She introduced her K-30 agenda to expand opportunity through education, jobs, and housing. She secured over $160 million in federal funding for clean water, public safety, child care, and affordable housing in OR-05. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Trump messed up on stage once again. body:
Join our Solidarity Community Call to figure out what we do next, together. | | | Peter, One moment Martin Soto was walking home, on his way back from buying diapers for his 4-year-old daughter. The next moment, he was being stopped by immigration officers and taken from his community. Now, his wife Gabriela has been left to take care of their children on her own. She visits Martin four times a week at Delaney Hall, a privately-run ICE facility in Newark where hundreds of our neighbors are currently detained. Last month, Martin and roughly 300 of our neighbors decided they had had enough. They launched a hunger and labor strike — refusing meals and refusing to work — to protest what we know are inhumane conditions inside: **overcrowding, no A/C, guards who mistreat them, medical care denied, and contaminated food with worms found in their meals.** Their courage has inspired hundreds of neighbors to take action too, with community members gathering outside the camp every day to raise up the voices of the individuals detained inside.**** Just recently,[ a father was finally freed and reunited with his children](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMWn3R7U15hZOprFI75oZg441nvnHRNxo065hGe5QymIvxL4RqKWuvg_sc-UlS2tOqER9LqVayIPdMLGImaG0Al2Ac0tk4wKT1p2GL9RcMkOMvka8gQoVrgYPCIdLl9w-q1uMG8BjgjDv2XRuvtTl_9MOgFR2neD6dGOLc1-h28e_SNT_u00nNlf7P0atj0Q_lH7JsVxpPAMjY63EPiFbU_HVpuhwQKiYnC0jOgxeW7HmqwlEY3lUktpxGqeZ5d8dw6Kde5vkfBV87woupGqo40RMpJEFqIQOA0X_CnE27dwucF08nUIcyot2KmDFgdz5Mw/4r6/KoYZN34cSBuYjKRvZY_Xkg/h0/h001.ABvx8x6vySK2tieuDAO8PbGa96GG0NUranVqWIQ7DJE). clean_body: Join our Solidarity Community Call to figure out what we do next, together. | | | Peter, One moment Martin Soto was walking home, on his way back from buying diapers for his 4-year-old daughter. The next moment, he was being stopped by immigration officers and taken from his community. Now, his wife Gabriela has been left to take care of their children on her own. She visits Martin four times a week at Delaney Hall, a privately-run ICE facility in Newark where hundreds of our neighbors are currently detained. Last month, Martin and roughly 300 of our neighbors decided they had had enough. They launched a hunger and labor strike — refusing meals and refusing to work — to protest what we know are inhumane conditions inside: overcrowding, no A/C, guards who mistreat them, medical care denied, and contaminated food with worms found in their meals. Their courage has inspired hundreds of neighbors to take action too, with community members gathering outside the camp every day to raise up the voices of the individuals detained inside.** Just recently,. All because people had the courage to come together and organize to make it happen.✊ Will you stand in solidarity with immigrant communities to continue exposing the horrible treatment of our neighbors inside ICE facilities, from New Jersey to every corner of the country? get a breakdown of everything unfolding right now: from the hunger strikes at Delaney Hall to ways our communities are showing up for each other. 🧡 At this call, you’ll: 🤝 Hear directly from advocates on the frontlines and learn how to join them in building lasting power together 👀 Get clarity on the rapidly shifting landscape, and how to make sense of the full picture together 🫂 Connect with neighbors around the country who, like you, are deciding to stand in solidarity with immigrant communities Peter, staying informed isn’t passive. It’s one of the ways we can show up for Martin, for his daughter, and for every family being torn apart right now. See you there, Ximena and the UWD team | Follow us on: | | | | |

Last night, I won my primary in California’s 48th Congressional District — and I wanted EMILYs List supporters to hear directly from me:

**Thank you.**

This campaign would not be where it is today without EMILYs List and the powerful community of supporters behind it.

From the earliest days of this race, EMILYs List’s support was much more than an endorsement. They have been a partner — helping our campaign sharpen our strategy, prepare for tough moments, make our case to voters, and build the kind of operation it will take to flip this Republican-held seat in November.

That kind of support makes a huge difference in a race like this one.

I’m running in a district Republicans have taken for granted for too long. I’ve beaten Republicans before, and I know what it takes to win tough fights: staying focused on the people we’re fighting for, telling the truth about what’s at stake, and building a campaign strong enough to withstand everything the other side throws our way.

And make no mistake: Now that we’re through the primary, Republicans will come after this campaign with everything they’ve got. They know this seat is one of the races that will decide control of the House, they know we have a real opportunity to flip CA-48, and they know that when Democratic pro-choice women have the resources and support to compete, we win.

**That’s why I’m so grateful to have EMILYs List in this fight.**

Because EMILYs List doesn’t just show up at the finish line. They show up early. They invest in women candidates when it matters most. They help campaigns like mine build the foundation we need to win.

Now, we have to take that work all the way through to November.

clean_body: EMILYs List has been with me from the beginning. And now, we’re ready for November. | = Hi Peter, it’s Marni von Wilpert. Last night, I won my primary in California’s 48th Congressional District — and I wanted EMILYs List supporters to hear directly from me: Thank you. This campaign would not be where it is today without EMILYs List and the powerful community of supporters behind it. = | = From the earliest days of this race, EMILYs List’s support was much more than an endorsement. They have been a partner — helping our campaign sharpen our strategy, prepare for tough moments, make our case to voters, and build the kind of operation it will take to flip this Republican-held seat in November. That kind of support makes a huge difference in a race like this one. I’m running in a district Republicans have taken for granted for too long. I’ve beaten Republicans before, and I know what it takes to win tough fights: staying focused on the people we’re fighting for, telling the truth about what’s at stake, and building a campaign strong enough to withstand everything the other side throws our way. And make no mistake: Now that we’re through the primary, Republicans will come after this campaign with everything they’ve got. They know this seat is one of the races that will decide control of the House, they know we have a real opportunity to flip CA-48, and they know that when Democratic pro-choice women have the resources and support to compete, we win. That’s why I’m so grateful to have EMILYs List in this fight. Because EMILYs List doesn’t just show up at the finish line. They show up early. They invest in women candidates when it matters most. They help campaigns like mine build the foundation we need to win. Now, we have to take that work all the way through to November. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = I’m ready for the fight ahead. ---|---|---
* **Mosquitoes Carry Wolbachia:** Bacteria-infected males mate with wild females causing eggs to fail to develop and hatch gradually reducing Aedes aegypti populations over generations without biting humans.

* **Elected Officials Criticize:** Tennessee Republican Representative Tim Burchett questioned why a technology company is involved and listed past invasive species disasters like kudzu and Asian carp.

# [Bitcoin "Perps" trigger Crypto exchange stock selloff](https://substack.com/redirect/eab098df-4cb2-4e6f-9494-6b5b77d6c949?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Exchange stocks tumbled after the **[Commodity Futures Trading Commission approved"perpetual futures"](https://substack.com/redirect/cbf2c9b5-8576-4784-b558-ecc0809e46af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for Bitcoin on Kalshi, sparking fears of increased competition for traditional Wall Street exchanges if the product expands to other asset classes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cbf2c9b5-8576-4784-b558-ecc0809e46af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Exchange Stocks Tumbling Sharply:** CME Group dropped more than 2 percent Tuesday and over 8 percent over the last two days while Cboe Global Markets plunged more than 8 percent in the session and over 17 percent for the week.
* **Perpetual Futures Expansion Feared:** Investors worry perpetual futures could extend to equity products displacing CME and Cboe S&P offerings and challenging the retail trading products that traditional exchanges dominate.
* **Kalshi Eyes Broader Rollout:** Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour said the platform is starting with Bitcoin perpetual futures then expanding noting perps see more than 90 trillion dollars in annual volume globally.
* **Selloff Called Overreaction:** Analysts describe the stock reaction as shooting first and asking questions later with fundamental differences in perpetual futures mechanisms and limited institutional interest so far.

Together, we have the chance to make history by electing the first Native American woman Governor in the country. But more than that, we have the chance to protect and build a New Mexico where working families can actually get ahead.
Because I know firsthand what’s at stake when leaders ignore people’s struggles. I know what it’s like to live paycheck to paycheck, to rely on food stamps and WIC, and to worry about whether your family can pay groceries and rent in the same month.
That’s why I’m so determined to fight for lower costs, build stronger schools to get kids reading earlier, expand and strengthen access to healthcare, and foster safer communities.
But this won’t be easy.

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.
