Peter,
As climate disasters like floods, fires, and hurricanes intensify, Big Oil companies are lobbying Congress for blanket immunity from any laws or legislation that could hold them accountable for fueling the crisis.
Will you join us in urging Congress to reject Big Oil’s call for immunity and to protect our right to hold fossil fuel companies accountable? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_ekkIQy7UkCy5U3NLti6mA2]
Add your name [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_ekkIQy7UkCy5U3NLti6mA2?contactdata=bDdsHgp3fXjCpqMRSfVG526Sovjf5qsltCCqaAz/+lwCvD96K/UqkyDjZukVgpcONIP8MO7p3WkdDyJPGfT6IFJGa0fw3SjY0IAVQGm/+RYe33x1c2MrMv8YatPl3qsU]
Big Oil companies knew decades ago that their fossil fuel products could cause “catastrophic” consequences, but they lied to the public to protect their profits. Now more than 1 in 4 people in the United States live in a state or community that is taking major fossil fuel companies to court to hold them accountable for this deception and a growing number of states are passing or considering Climate Superfund laws that would make polluters pay for the growing costs of climate damages.
Big Oil is turning to its allies in the Trump administration and Congress to try and secure an industry-wide “liability waiver” that could help them escape accountability and take away our right to make corporations pay when they cause harm. We must stop them.
Sign this petition to Congress to oppose giving Big Oil a “get-out-of-jail-free” card. Together we can win this fight and protect our progress. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_ekkIQy7UkCy5U3NLti6mA2]
Thank you for taking action,

body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
HuffPost: Mail-In Voters Could Face A New Obstacle This Midterm Season [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=060326_2&amount=25]
Team: Changes at the U.S. Postal Service are going to make a known problem even worse, and it could affect thousands of voters across the country in this November’s midterm elections.
Legally speaking, the date stamped on your mail is when it counts as being sent, from your bills to your taxes to your ballot. For decades, that's been stamped the day you gave it to the United States Postal Service (USPS), whether you handed it to your mail carrier, left it in a mailbox, or dropped it at the local post office.
That's no longer the case. Your mail will be stamped the day it hits a regional processing facility , not your local post office. That could be a day, or more, later than when you handed your mail over, thanks to the Trump administration's "cost-cutting" efforts.
How does this impact vote-by-mail? If you live in a state with a mail-in ballot grace period -- something most states still have, even though MAGA is trying to end those -- your ballot still counts if it was postmarked by Election Day and received in the grace period after Election Day. In this case, however, a ballot mailed on Election Day may not be postmarked as Election Day, making your ballot automatically invalid even though you followed the rule of law and the postmark date is out of your control.
Of course, this was followed by the recent news that USPS won't deliver your ballot unless your state put your name on Trump's list -- usurping the Constitution and trying to take control of elections away from the states in order to suppress the vote.
Team, Every voter needs to know about these massive changes. Will you pitch in $35 or whatever you can today and help us spread the word about the new USPS rules so we can protect mail-in ballots? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=060326_2&amount=35]

We're worried about every mail-in voter getting their ballot in on time, but especially those most vulnerable to these changes, like the elderly, rural Americans who live far from USPS regional facilities, our military service members, and young people who are voting by mail away from home. None of them deserve to be disenfranchised from our elections over DOGE's cost-cutting measures or Trump's conspiracies about mail-in ballots.
Whether you can fuel our work today or not, we appreciate your support and we hope you can spread the word about these USPS changes to your friends, family, and colleagues. You never know how a quick mention of something like this news might truly impact someone else's life.

Legally speaking, the date stamped on your mail is when it counts as being sent, from your bills to your taxes to your ballot. For decades, that's been stamped the day you gave it to the United States Postal Service (USPS), whether you handed it to your mail carrier, left it in a mailbox, or dropped it at the local post office. That's no longer the case. Your mail will be stamped the day it hits a regional processing facility , not your local post office. That could be a day, or more, later than when you handed your mail over, thanks to the Trump administration's "cost-cutting" efforts. How does this impact vote-by-mail? If you live in a state with a mail-in ballot grace period -- something most states still have, even though MAGA is trying to end those -- your ballot still counts if it was postmarked by Election Day and received in the grace period after Election Day. In this case, however, a ballot mailed on Election Day may not be postmarked as Election Day, making your ballot automatically invalid even though you followed the rule of law and the postmark date is out of your control. Of course, this was followed by the recent news that USPS won't deliver your ballot unless your state put your name on Trump's list -- usurping the Constitution and trying to take control of elections away from the states in order to suppress the vote. | We know. We know. We're only a few days into the month and here we are already talking about June 30.

But here’s the thing. Our FEC deadline at the end of this month is one of the most important moments of this entire campaign. Friends, today I’m introducing new legislation to address the growing role that AI is playing in discrimination, and I wanted to make sure we got a chance to talk about it:
https://secure.ngpvan.com/ZAz76KiUA02D_PgUF_NOsQ2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/ZAz76KiUA02D_PgUF_NOsQ2]
AI is already making decisions about whether you get a job, a loan, housing, health care, and more.
It can cause real harm — but unlike human discrimination, which is easier to identify, algorithmic discrimination is a lot harder to see, prevent, and hold anyone accountable for.
Federal agencies are already enforcing laws in these areas, but there isn’t a clear or coordinated way to make sure these laws are being enforced when it’s AI (not a human) that’s causing these harms. This creates a patchwork and inconsistent guidance across the different agencies, as well as loopholes that AI systems are already exploiting.
My bill, the Sectoral AI Governance Act , or SAGA, fixes these loopholes for all federal agencies. It will give federal agencies a blueprint for writing and making rules about AI whenever these systems are likely to cause the same harms that those agencies are meant to tackle.
In other words, my bill will help federal agencies enforce existing laws when AI breaks them.
People are already concerned enough about AI taking their jobs and violating their rights – and they’re right to be! – so we need to create a clear framework that guarantees our existing rights and protections and prevents discrimination and harm.
If you agree, please add your name today to support my new legislation. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/ZAz76KiUA02D_PgUF_NOsQ2]

Thank you so much for reading and for your support.
–Sara

# [Here's what's going to decide this race:](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=200307136&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjAwMzA3MTM2LCJpYXQiOjE3ODA1MTM1MTgsImV4cCI6MTc4MzEwNTUxOCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.eMVm1gwKo370apKL23G7y_xYziNYc-4_0OdO2eDNSjU)
### Hint: It starts with "inde" and ends with "pendents"
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jun 3
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..Ea7TjkaZ7qXDVIo2NYqbRo_ge0tKJP7kaA1P-mGfiiM?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/heres-whats-going-to-decide-this?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
There's a phrase that I've heard time and again when talking about this race and my campaign, and it means more to me than almost anything else that's been said about this race:
**Independent magic.**
I don't have a crystal ball, but I can make this prediction with confidence: Election Day is going to come down to the wire. Michigan's Senate election in 2024 was decided by just _0.3%_ of the vote - and poll after poll tells us that this year is going to be just as close.
And when the margins are that slim, there's one key demographic that it all comes down to: _independent voters._
They are the ones who are going to decide this race. That's the truth. _**That 's how you win in Michigan.**_
And the other truth is this: None of my primary opponents come close to me in that department.
**[I'm leading in](https://substack.com/redirect/79e57581-a8ca-4bdf-bccc-9497f7b7ad97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** _**[9 polls](https://substack.com/redirect/79e57581-a8ca-4bdf-bccc-9497f7b7ad97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**[. That's huge.](https://substack.com/redirect/79e57581-a8ca-4bdf-bccc-9497f7b7ad97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
What it comes down to is that voters, whether Democrats or independents, know what we've been saying all along.
Michiganders can count on me to fight for them - and win - because it's what I've been doing throughout my career.
It's what I did as President Obama's Chief of Staff on the Auto Rescue Task Force before I was elected to Congress, when we helped save 200,000 auto jobs in Michigan during the Great Recession.
Since coming to Congress, my record speaks for itself. I mean, come on - there's a reason my name and "most effective" are brought up a lot together. I've helped pass the:
* CHIPS and Science Act
* Building Blocks of STEM Act
* American Manufacturing Leadership Act
* Butch Lewis Act
* And more!

**And I 'm not done yet, folks. I'm ready to keep delivering for the state that raised me as Michigan's next senator.**
That's what "independent magic" is really about. And it's why I'm the only Democrat in this race with a real shot at defeating Mike Rogers and keeping this seat blue.
With grit and determination,
Haley
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/79e57581-a8ca-4bdf-bccc-9497f7b7ad97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/79e57581-a8ca-4bdf-bccc-9497f7b7ad97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1458%2E1086043%2EODo55c)
I want to tell you something I don’t say enough, Peter.
_Four years ago, when I first ran for office, we polled lower than "Not Voting."**Seriously.** 🙃 _
I had never run for political office. Few people had heard of me. The Democratic Party had handpicked other candidates. I didn't have any real name recognition.
**But I did not let fear lead. Because my journey has always been an improbable one.**
I grew up as the son of an immigrant single mother. I didn't come from money or prestige. I came from hard work, community, and an unshakable belief that Maryland could be better.
And that is exactly how we went from polling at 1% to winning our race. Through a lot of grit, working alongside the grassroots, and fighting to leave no one behind. We traveled from Oakland to Ocean City. We listened. And we won — _by double digits._
**_This campaign will be no different. We are going everywhere and listening to everyone to build an even bigger grassroots movement._** This campaign won’t be powered by big checks or special interests. It’s being powered by you.
**[Can you chip in $5 today to help us do it again? I’ll need your support every step of the way from now until Election Day.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260603-1.zbswUw&refcode=em-20260603-1&t=2&akid=1458%2E1086043%2EODo55c)**

Based on preliminary reporting, I received the majority of votes in the June Primary to continue serving as California Secretary of State.

I was born in the Jim Crow South to sharecroppers who were denied the right to vote. California gave our family a new beginning — my parents cast their first ballots here and even opened our living room as a polling place for our neighbors. That is the California I have dedicated my life to protecting.

**Every day in office, I carry that history with me – and I look forward to continuing my work as Secretary of State once re-elected in November.**

We are not in normal times. There are forces working right now to shorten polling hours, reduce early voting days, eliminate vote-by-mail, and intimidate the election workers who make democracy run.

**I will continue to do everything in my power to defend Californians’ right to vote, and ensure our elections are operated with transparency, integrity, and efficiency.**

In the coming months, I look forward to sharing my vision with voters and opposing any efforts to restrict Californians' access to the ballot.

**_[In order to do that, I need the resources necessary to run a modern campaign across all 58 California counties. Will you make a donation today to power my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132649145/625215306/-197698243?refcode=web-em-fr-20260603-PostPrimary-365do-l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMzQ3ZjZmOS03ZjVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9bc6HXooZirGEftMOhMt4irqbrNwr6ajmF0xa5O26fY=)_**

Together, let’s keep fighting to ensure that every Californian has the opportunity to participate in safe, transparent, and accessible elections.

Onward,

-Dr. Shirley N. Weber

| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132649552/625215865/1392951796?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_ElecIntegrityFund_260603_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWJkZjcwMS04MDVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1hZYlLseXfHk0cwSuTimyY6ARyI1C6aXThnaqFlJNwI=) Derek,

I’m not being hyperbolic when I say this: I am deeply concerned about President Trump’s efforts to undermine our democracy, and what they could mean for the midterms.

Derek, my concern isn’t hypothetical. As the top Democrat on the Senate Intelligence Committee, I've spent years working to protect our elections from interference. And frankly, what I’m seeing from Trump and his allies presents a very real threat to the integrity of our elections:
* Trump has openly called for the federal government to "take over" our elections and override the states that have always run them.

* He signed an executive order directing his administration to build its own list of who's eligible to vote – and to block the Postal Service from mailing a ballot to anyone the federal government leaves off that list.

* He's still peddling conspiracy theories about the 2020 election he lost, even sending his National Intelligence Director to an FBI search at a Georgia election office to try and justify his unfounded claims of election fraud.

* And his allies in Congress are pushing the SAVE Act, which would force voters to produce documentary proof of citizenship, a requirement that could block millions of eligible Americans, including married women whose names have changed, from registering.

**These actions are wrong and dangerous – and have real consequences on our elections.**

In our Commonwealth, we have incredibly important elections this November – races that could determine control of Congress. We need to make sure every eligible voter can freely exercise their right and make their voice heard. And we need to make sure that _Virginia_ is in charge of running our elections – _not the Trump administration._

[_**That’s why today, my campaign is launching the Election Integrity Fund to combat Trump’s election fraud and dirty tricks here in Virginia.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132649553/625215866/1392951796?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_ElecIntegrityFund_260603_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWJkZjcwMS04MDVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1hZYlLseXfHk0cwSuTimyY6ARyI1C6aXThnaqFlJNwI=)

This fundraising goal will help us put real resources behind protecting the vote. We can make sure Virginians know their rights and have somewhere to turn if they're wrongly turned away. We can build up election protection efforts in communities across the state. And we can make sure we’re ready to push back, including in court, when anyone tries to keep eligible voters from casting a ballot.

I’m taking these threats to our voting rights and election processes seriously. Free and fair elections are the bedrock of our democracy, and we absolutely must protect them.

[_**That’s why I’m asking: can you donate to our Election Integrity Fund? We’ve set a goal of raising $50,000 before the middle of the month to help this campaign stand up for our democracy and protect our elections >>>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132649554/625215867/1392951796?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_ElecIntegrityFund_260603_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWJkZjcwMS04MDVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1hZYlLseXfHk0cwSuTimyY6ARyI1C6aXThnaqFlJNwI=) ********[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132649555/625215868/1392951796?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_ElecIntegrityFund_260603_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWJkZjcwMS04MDVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1hZYlLseXfHk0cwSuTimyY6ARyI1C6aXThnaqFlJNwI=)******** The fight continues,

clean_body: What's happening now could shape the next election | Peter, I won’t sugarcoat it — what we’re seeing right now in Florida should Over the past few weeks, there have been clear warning signs that the Left is stepping up its efforts to gain ground in communities across our state. And they’re treating local races as the first step in a much larger strategy. We’re seeing it play out in real time: well-funded Democratic campaigns, national money flowing into local contests, and coordinated messaging designed to flip long-held Republican areas. And they believe momentum is building..... Here’s what this broader pattern looks like right now: Across Florida: Democrats are investing heavily in local and municipal races they previously ignored. Nationally: The Left continues pushing candidates and policies focused on open borders, higher taxes, and expanded government control. In major cities: Progressive leadership is doubling down on policies that have led to rising costs, strained services, and public safety concerns. Florida Democrats and their allies are framing these local gains as proof that the political landscape is shifting — and they’re openly signaling that the midterms are their next target. Out-of-state money is already flowing into Florida at scale, and national organizations are treating our state as one of the top battlegrounds in the country. ---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

clean_body: This is happening faster than we can keep up | | | | | Patriot, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Patriot, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

clean_body: I've lived service and sacrifice — and I've seen what happens when politicians put their own power over the American people. | Peter, My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a proud Minnesota native, combat veteran, and former Navy SEAL. This past weekend, I won the Republican Party’s endorsement for the United States Senate. I joined the Marines after 9/11 and fought in the brutal Battle of Najaf in Iraq. I later became a Navy SEAL, deploying nine times to 70 countries in defense of this nation. I’ve lived service and sacrifice — and I’ve seen what happens when politicians put their own power over the American people. I have watched Minnesota Governor Tim Walz abandon Minneapolis as riots destroyed a Target near my sister’s home. I watched on as liberal activists stormed the streets of Minnesota with disregard for fellow citizens, law enforcement, or political opposition. That moment changed everything. I knew I had to step up and fight for our state and our country. For the past year, I’ve been hitting the ground every single day — attending local Republican events and meetings, listening to Minnesotans, and earning the trust of the grassroots.That hard work paid off. After a hard-fought convention in Duluth, Minnesota, I won the Republican Party of Minnesota's endorsement. As my momentum has grown, my opponents have started coming after me hard. Even after the delegates made their choice, my now primary opponent has decided to ignore grassroots, not honor the endorsement and run against me in the August primary anyway. Here’s what’s at stake: In the last 60 years, there has never been a Republican U.S. Senate nominee in Minnesota who did not first win the party’s endorsement. This victory puts us on the strongest possible path forward. I’m a Christian, a combat-proven veteran, and a fighter who puts America First — secure borders, strong national defense, election integrity, and protecting life. I’m not a career politician. I’m the outsider who has actually served this country in uniform. But I can’t do this without you. With the primary ahead, will help us defeat Tafoya in August, fuel our ground game, and build the momentum we need to defeat Tim Walz’s Lt. Governor Peggy Flannagan this fall! Will you stand with me today? Thank you for believing in this fight. God bless you, and God bless the United States of America. name: Deb Haaland
subject: I'm officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Are you ready, New Mexico?!

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=10108%2E400544%2EOrrM3Q)
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk836-fr-nd&t=2&akid=10108%2E400544%2EOrrM3Q)
**I am officially the Democratic nominee for Governor of New Mexico!**
| | [Chip in to keep this incredible momentum going](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk836-fr-nd&t=3&akid=10108%2E400544%2EOrrM3Q)
---
This is a huge milestone, friend — and it's one I couldn't have reached without you. **_Thank you._**

I’m a daughter of Pueblo women, a New Mexican, a single mother, and a former small-business owner. I’ve served as a Congresswoman and became the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history. **_[And when we win this race in November, I will be the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk836-fr-nd&t=4&akid=10108%2E400544%2EOrrM3Q)_**
Thanks to supporters like you, we're now one step closer to delivering for working families and making our vision of a New Mexico for New Mexicans a reality.
But there’s still a long road to November, and Republicans are already watching to see whether we can keep this momentum going — and are ready to spend anything to bring their extremist agenda here.
Our campaign has always been about New Mexicans building something together. I am ready to deliver stronger schools, affordable childcare and housing, higher wages, support for small businesses, better healthcare access, and safer communities. The general election is about more than what we stand to lose. It’s about what we stand to gain.
So, are you ready New Mexico?

Are you ready to fight for lower costs?

Are you ready to fight for healthcare?

Are you ready to fight for safe communities?

Are you ready to fight for education?

Are you ready to show Donald Trump and his administration that, here in New Mexico, we believe in dignity and respect?
I’m ready to lead New Mexico forward. I’ve lived the challenges working families are facing and taken on tough fights to deliver real results. I know what it takes to win in November — but I can’t do it alone. ** _[So please, will you chip in to help me hit our first $50,000 general election goal, win this November, and keep New Mexico blue?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10403?refcode=jtk836-fr-nd&t=5&akid=10108%2E400544%2EOrrM3Q)_**

Twice a week at 8am we are giving out free coffees, this week Wednesday and Thursday we'll be at the Greenpoint Ave and Bedford Ave stations! Julie's mission includes all of us -- from Queensbridge to Fort Greene, Julie's policies have and will continue to support us all. So together lets end all wars, abolish ICE, bring down cost of living, and provide New Yorkers a Lifetime of Care! We look forward to seeing you soon! Team Won

name: Andrew Sypher, Turning Point USA
subject: If you love America, read this first
body:
Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit — with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools.| | |
---
| | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

clean_body: Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit — with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools.| | | | | Peter, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Peter... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Peter -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... It closes for good. That's what's at stake. Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- while it still matters. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. I need you to hear this clearly... Charlie Kirk wasn't just dreaming big when he called me last year about Club America's progress. He was warning us: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. Look around. Club America may be in 13% of high schools... But in the other 87%? There is no pushback against the Left. No one telling those kids the truth. Just a Leftist pipeline -- from classroom... to belief... to voting booth. And once that pipeline is complete... It 's over. Peter, this is one of the last places a patriot like you can stop it before it 's too late to save our country. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will. There's still time to turn this country around... and this is one of the few ways we can actually do it -- one student, one school, one chapter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044 If you would like to opt-out of important updates like this,

clean_body: A few quick questions for you → | Friend, as votes are still being counted in some of the most competitive primaries of 2026, I want to thank you for your continued support of my Climate PAC. I know you have a hundred things pulling at your time and attention, including a painful news cycle that reminds us just how far the Trump Administration will go to consolidate power. It is easy to look away. It is much harder to keep showing up, to keep supporting our fearless candidates, and most of all, to keep investing in this work I believe in with all of my heart. I'm truly grateful to call you a member of this grassroots movement. And it’s time to bring you into this next chapter of our work, as many of our candidates head into the general election. Right now, my team and I are taking a hard look at what's working, what needs to shift, and how JanePAC can rise to meet this political moment with the strength and clarity it demands. Before we take that next step, I want to hear from you. | In solidarity, xx Jane Fonda | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Dear Friend of Liberty,

As we approach America's 250th anniversary, I have a question for you: **what story will the next generation learn about our country?**

You're an intelligent and civically engaged person. So, you know that right now, far too many colleges and universities teach young people a distorted view of America--as if our nation were built on injustice instead of liberty.

This false story robs college students--our future leaders--of a proper understanding of our American heritage and weakens the informed patriotism that preserves our freedom.

**But you can change that --and receive "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope," one of our most popular online courses, as a DVD box set--for FREE.**

Taught by historian Wilfred McClay and based on his published history of America, "**The Great American Story: A Land of Hope** " presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. It's a magnificent course, perfect for in-home viewing or with a small study group.

We produced this course to help restore intelligent patriotism, especially in young people, which is essential for the survival of free government.

**Will you take two simple steps right now?**

* First, claim your free copy of "The Great American Story" DVD box set to add to your home library. Simply tell us where to send it, and we'll ship it to your preferred address. There's no other obligation on your part!
* Second, after claiming your free DVD box set, consider helping place this course and other outreach efforts in homes nationwide by making a tax-deductible gift. That way, millions more Americans, especially young people, can learn the truth about our nation's history.

**But supplies are limited, so please act now using this secure link:
**
**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/free-great-american-story-dvd](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/Xus8LFuj53LilozFMAmwQ0QCDqQ0EbYUO-jUkZwzWyRnCiMeEaMeBF9veZfFs50tN15xPEkWnYYZtQNY7U8CAXIFj2ryG2IAfEMRfzDAI_owizCDYDaNLUsjANM7fbenXgy9v-HGn4YBEfhIe4oZ_oonyHep0wvo_3CtIZM1oEarFu4FYof6Y4JUpMi-fryB5EXbrNlE1a7T3ZHDCNOqt8Onz82uVOE1TzvWqYW7NIgA1sLKQc9c_6vtRdF9qYc9VrxULqqjQQW0a4qAar_4yzNhi4soKz_fp5NNzBbIgn5DQZiVaXozxRyiO0FvZKwjxrj2tvtcAMs4njUPLdR1Sk48nlsY1A2bBg3qw1DS1Ln-b5mxi70QVfKeit2QQlTz4ZwlhriMwDVSq0OeO8tlvbo52TXS_4xabJmAtYP8l5ufrPYPb3HjS4FjAEwVCt4PilCzkQD1Elya-8ivy7oFqHC21ETpgog-KSYCXYf-9QdKG_QyY9PEYmI-K2rLD3clm5F0OLQNEo0O3mbVIogqbeAROJHN1hdeCre9u1AjjrmRoLn2d06jg9v0SflJMCgSa0hiTqusz5Oo_E6pVVMIPMgLP72UXR7XBEPnAeURkgS-XtChNaDvMO_p_-h8ha7iSmvOcRcG4FxlK8gtFr_hmSn1kpVnjUrbbYLplYQb6eOEw0NJ9F_jmTkNKVmysMgrccoVwpqkM13SoHyTMCbF-U0-BQmPSQM/wTiNL-CfeQ9kaqsZoW5pOQ21ZHSixuOx/21)**

If we don't teach the truth, young people will likely only hear lies--that America is an essentially unjust nation and unworthy of our love. We cannot let that happen, especially as America prepares to mark its 250th anniversary.

**You can make a difference.** With your gift today, you will help restore intelligent patriotism in the hearts of millions of Americans, just in time for the 250th celebration!

Thank you for helping others learn the truth about our history and America's great heritage of liberty. You are a true friend of freedom.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Hillsdale College

Friend, Americans who lose their voting rights don't get compensation funds. But an election official convicted of compromising election equipment just might. Tina Peters was a Colorado county clerk who helped fuel election conspiracy theories after the 2020 election. A jury later convicted her of helping facilitate unauthorized access to election equipment, and a judge sentenced her to nine years in prison. Yet after serving less than two years, Colorado Governor Jared Polis commuted her sentence, and Peters was released from prison on June 1. Within hours of her release, Peters appeared on Steve Bannon's podcast and continued spreading false claims about American elections and voting machines. Rather than accepting responsibility for her actions, Peters claimed Democrats would "cheat" in upcoming elections and repeated the debunked conspiracy theory that voting machines allow votes to be flipped — the same kind of election misinformation that has undermined public trust in our democracy for years. And now, some of the same election denial figures who championed Peters' release are demanding retaliation against the officials who investigated and prosecuted her. Others are raising money to cover her legal expenses and celebrate her return to public life. Across America, voters face registration barriers, polling place closures, long lines, and attacks on voting rights that rarely make national headlines. And across America, convicted criminals who attacked our democracy are let off the hook or rewarded. One set of rules for ordinary voters. Another for the people who would use the system to their own benefit. **Election officials who violate the public trust should be held accountable.** **[If you believe voting rights deserve more name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Flipping Texas isn’t just a dream
body:
We know what voters really think in Texas.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Winning in Texas isn’t just a dream anymore, Peter.
It can be our reality this November, and we’re already seeing the signs.
Texas is the state that people always write off as a solid red state — but we know what’s really happening on the ground. In local elections, Texans are choosing new leaders for city councils, school boards, and mayor’s offices in places we’re always told are “out of reach.”
And everywhere we go, we hear the same thing. Texans are tired of Greg Abbott and the Republican leadership that’s been ruining our state for decades. Fellow Patriot,

We won the Republican primary!

I want you to hear it directly from me: thank you!

This victory belongs to every single person who stepped up, chipped in, and believed in this campaign when it was just getting started.

But I'm not going to pretend last night was the finish line. It isn't.

The Democrats have been watching this race. Chuck Schumer and his dark money machine have been waiting to see who they'd be up against in November. Now they know. And they are already coming for us.

They are going to pour millions into Montana to try to buy this Senate seat. Coastal liberal donors from California and New York are going to fund attack after attack. They want to flip Montana blue and flip the Senate with it.

Peter, Having been elected as Mayor of my community twice, I know firsthand that campaigns can be unpredictable. But I have to say that I did not expect to be relaunching a campaign in the middle of a campaign that had already begun. But here we are. And I want you to know what this month has meant to me. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/kDV0N5oTB_6u_MUAZvM63g~~/AAUS1hA~/tR2iAxsQ4MZ3ielpmSkqM0S5JZu10DlxoGbxHmPTb7slkJDit_zeIT6SzY7EZCsgt5-xzL2JAelU8uxKshVP5JxdwOxMIjVjbOuy2LmW1TTuMa2xPijN9ktRHs6gQ4GwPjEhMUcbFHT_NenoURediE65wSHLBkyImkCYYizN7AoEj5yz-9v_os5AU-K8B57ojy8uAVTXrqNHgSrMivKdu3d5rzxrAnTLt769PE441bYyYNKO8pvxYOZRjox58g5K) When things got hard, our community got louder. That is not something you can manufacture. People reached out who had never been involved in a campaign before. Folks in parts of this new district that did not even know our name a few weeks ago started paying attention. And through all of it, the people who had been with us from the beginning never flinched. That tells me something about this race. And it tells me something about Tennessee. I have never been someone who backs down when things get difficult. But I also know I cannot do this alone. The fact that I do not have to is something I will carry with me long after this campaign is over, whatever the outcome. So from the bottom of my heart, thank you. For your patience, your generosity, and your faith that this is worth fighting for. It is. We can win. — Chaz | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/S2J_GClOjLWOxkxXQd0PZQ~~/AAUS1hA~/-CHMCD1_BuwVirAGdm0G57i8qWbN97k9ctLWZiVL5DgQV3L7PiRXliIr6vcAu9WJh5yB9yrJVO8uClzjKdcG6gh4WOEZ5jvoq3PIpcLyPM-YrNOF2TpAQdAxPjI0BiIwzC-PsVRPNn3x30h3Y7Q6zh8uXzsjgFMZpQtzabtiT-6Pwkb0o5j1J5KFqGiYymrrwlOvuk8E19n1i3pdIEFnb-4v2mrHNLcInkzuQyZBS7HwhyM91WpRw_sfVrooRSEN)

clean_body: When things got tough, this community got louder. | | | | | Peter, Having been elected as Mayor of my community twice, I know firsthand that campaigns can be unpredictable. But I have to say that I did not expect to be relaunching a campaign in the middle of a campaign that had already begun. But here we are. And I want you to know what this month has meant to me. When things got hard, our community got louder. That is not something you can manufacture. People reached out who had never been involved in a campaign before. Folks in parts of this new district that did not even know our name a few weeks ago started paying attention. And through all of it, the people who had been with us from the beginning never flinched. That tells me something about this race. And it tells me something about Tennessee. I have never been someone who backs down when things get difficult. But I also know I cannot do this alone. The fact that I do not have to is something I will carry with me long after this campaign is over, whatever the outcome. So from the bottom of my heart, thank you. For your patience, your generosity, and your faith that this is worth fighting for. It is. We can win. — Chaz | | | | ---|---|--- About Chaz Molder Chaz Molder is the Mayor of Columbia, Tennessee, serving since 2019 and re-elected in 2022. A Columbia native and graduate of the University of Tennessee and the University of Memphis Law School, he returned home to build a career in law and public service. As mayor, he founded the Columbia Mayor’s Youth Council to promote civic engagement among young people and emphasizes the importance of being present and responsive to the community. | | | ~~ Click~~ to receive fewer emails. I’m Josh Turek. I’m a Democratic state legislator who won a deep red seat,
four-time Paralympian, and two-time gold medalist in wheelchair
basketball.

I thought the feeling of winning my first gold medal at the 2016 Rio
Paralympics would only come once in a lifetime. But, last night the race
was called:

I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Iowa’s open U.S. Senate seat.

Peter, grassroots energy usually peaks in the first few days
after a primary, so we have to get down to business ASAP. [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-june26-turek.3Xg5MQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_EOM_AC_20260603_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=5464%2E35263%2E3SsdTu ]Will you help
me make the most of our hard-fought victory by splitting a donation
between my campaign and Tammy Baldwin to become one of the first Founding
Donors of my General Election campaign?

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-june26-turek.3Xg5MQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_EOM_AC_20260603_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=5464%2E35263%2E3SsdTu ]Split a donation!

I’m honored that the people of Iowa have put their faith in me, and I’m
ready to take this once-in-a-generation shot to win this OPEN seat and be
the champion working people deserve in Washington.

I got into this race because like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed
up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes and
tired of perpetually playing defense.

I won this primary because I played offense, and I’m going to run a
relentless full-court press to win this seat in November.

I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your
support alone, will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than
a decade and take back the Senate Majority.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-june26-turek.3Xg5MQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_EOM_AC_20260603_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=5464%2E35263%2E3SsdTu ]I’m personally asking you to become one of our first General Election
Founding Donors by splitting a contribution of $15, $20, $35, or more
today. Your contribution will power my voter outreach so I can flip Joni
Ernst’s Senate seat and restore hope and faith in the great state of Iowa.

[ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-june26-turek.3Xg5MQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_EOM_AC_20260603_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=5464%2E35263%2E3SsdTu ]Split a donation!

a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst,
Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast
of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially.

But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back
victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one
point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson.

This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now.

We have 152 days to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie
Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA
megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the
future.

Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and
our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost
primary victory.

The outcome of this race will decide the Senate majority with huge
implications for our country, so my team and I need every single solitary
ounce of support to hit the ground rolling. [ https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=stb-em-june26-turek.3Xg5MQ&refcode=AU_STB_FR_TAN_EOM_AC_20260603_PM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=5464%2E35263%2E3SsdTu ]Will you rush a split

Friend,

Government works best when it is focused on delivering practical results for our families, not carving out special exceptions for the powerful.

But a new report from Axios highlighted a massive reminder of how broken the system in Washington really is.

According to the report, a lack of transparency and guardrails around Donald Trump’s financial accounts—ranging from traditional stock transactions to cryptocurrency workarounds—is allowing him to capitalize on a rigged system. Without standard ethical boundaries, these special interest setups shield the powerful and ensure they avoid paying their fair share to the IRS.

When Donald Trump and top officials play by a completely different set of rules than everyday families, it directly threatens our democracy. We need representatives in Congress who are entirely focused on transparency, accountability, and the needs of our neighbors.

That’s why I don’t own any individual stocks. And that’s why I’ve co-sponsored the Restore Trust in Government Act to prohibit elected officials—including members of Congress and the President—from owning or trading individual stocks.

We are entering the final stretch before June 23rd, and our organizers are out knocking on doors every single day. But standing up to corporate corruption and keeping our team on the ground requires a reliable base of grassroots support.

subject: We're in a Strong Position
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Eric Jones for Congress_
body:
| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/VbXwp0tuDjR?e=2ce0ad0449&c2id=45350b27067c85fdcb9eb8e5b2087927)
| | | | | | Hi ,
While ballots are still being counted and the race remains too close to call, one thing is already clear: this campaign has exceeded every expectation and demonstrated that voters across California's 4th Congressional District are ready for change. **We are still confident in our chances to progress into the General Election.**

But as expected, California's vote count will continue for days and even weeks. Many ballots remain outstanding, and we have always believed our coalition would be strongest among voters who cast their ballots later in the process. There are nearly 50% of ballots that still need to be counted — and we believe they are our base voters — younger, more democratic, working-class, and people of color.
When we launched this campaign, we took on a 28-year incumbent with universal name recognition, the backing of Washington insiders, and millions of dollars in outside spending.
The political establishment said we couldn't compete. Last night, we proved otherwise.
Just months ago, many viewed this race as an afterthought. Today, it is one of the most closely watched congressional contests in California because thousands of voters have rallied behind a simple idea: our district deserves a new generation of leadership.
**That's why we remain confident that we will advance to the November Election.**
What we saw last night confirms what we've heard throughout this campaign: voters are looking for fresh leadership, new energy, and someone who understands the challenges facing working families.
No matter how long the counting takes, that reality isn't changing.
I'm incredibly proud of the movement we've built together. Volunteers knocked on thousands of doors. Supporters made calls, sent texts, contributed what they could, and helped carry this message into every corner of the district. And we're just getting started.
We will continue monitoring the results, ensuring every vote is counted, and preparing for the next phase of this campaign.
Thank you for believing in me.
Thank you for believing in this movement.
And thank you for believing that the future of this district is still ahead of us. The path forward is clear, and I have never been more optimistic about where we're headed.
With gratitude,
Eric Jones

---
| | Peter,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=24785ee579ab456a9d8f6545979f74f1&_e=KRl3SmKYF_Bt1VZyXLJr9o2sShxc_y-Gq4nQmd46yDPDhmAUAdQVogpD6Wyy7U3NZvNEf4vD90FqbqYQbWb_gBdIYMmA7ArzPnPbkZt6xroWdiaqdJNuBUMOlExtHEyJNlgQQmwdRqMT-wt-FlNL3mXRFl0Gnr4XkTv4uGEHO9wMK1iPAVGoy9akcVZ6oxOeRGd-4pKaMPtYMIFXk5Tn1V-h3pJV0gpRUCHPkJOPygEf9TDHhBYd3MKUb46VfRvFkRoIuQyGsQmIMbpJvYG2WzyyYDNGZQpkT97pqYpMa14tRkbH96rp-I2Fw0orEhjq1k_BZm9smRSB5rvVpYPHPMDZUNRuD_GPOFpCzaMExxg7_c0upiG3nS5TIhtbfzY7M7qRx9VtyRaq4DfWtcwb1WzuCwVtLPrTFHA5_pPmtJNlPyFU4q8S9wyyx6Zj98chUpxRtrD8BHBDw7g9_DqLYzLNHCccjb5Fww0jAzUqwlWNp39TIh3-oRf7E28ibgNCdtdNXI2u4783p_WLafzvR49LAEUpi51opi7WHhwgUNO7xbg6tBEUS4Bx1MJ2_yxoJt4KoRT9JhhJg-Ll0pbuRMmKh02dVe9wQE_vhWF9-1JHIaNY6F_9tAsZsywERGtDaqAu2NFjMSPsSrzUCbc6_kzez9qa0pro9DoyUL8bx4L9KcwZ1boZiVFSFjGxpXCw6mMRGPzh4ziEKTQDN6NnPg%3D%3D)
---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

clean_body: | | | | | Peter, I'm going to be blunt with you. We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit. Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way." Right now. And the scariest part? It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms. High schools. Colleges. Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped. If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: " What happened to this country?" You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly. Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything... The other side is doing something far more dangerous. They're raising the next generation. Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places. That's how countries are lost. Slowly. Then all at once. But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope... There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged. And it shouldn 't even exist. Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That alone felt like a miracle. Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have. Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down. And yet... They stepped up anyway. About that time, Charlie called me. He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent. "Andrew, we've got to move faster." I told him we were. He stopped me. "No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I actually laughed. "Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said. "How many are there?" "About 27,000." And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000." I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet. But Charlie wasn't fazed. " We'll figure it out." That was him. He didn't wait for perfect conditions. Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... we lose everything. And now? Less than a year later... We 're in 3,300 schools. Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. That shouldn 't be possible. Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day. And yet... it's still happening. But Peter, here 's the part you need to understand: This is not a victory. It's a foothold. Because in the other 87% of schools? There is no resistance. None. Just one-sided propaganda from the Left. One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them. That's the reality. The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are. The question is whether it's enough. Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America... They're not the majority. They 're the exception. They're the ones willing to take the heat. The ones willing to stand alone. The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: " I love this country." And every time one of those students raises their hand... We have a choice. Back them. Or leave them on their own. Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. Everything they need to actually stand their ground. Not symbolically. For real. They've already made the decision to lead. All they're waiting on... is you and me. Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. $25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school. $25 to put real tools in their hands. $25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time. But here's what gives me hope, Peter... Club America isn't slowing down. It's accelerating. Because every day, more students are stepping forward. Not because it's easy or popular... But because they know what 's at stake. They're starting chapters in schools where they were told not to. They're speaking truth in classrooms where the Left once went unchallenged. They're choosing courage in places designed to make them conform. And they're not alone. They're finding each other. They're bringing more students with them every day. They're building something real -- rooted in faith and freedom, grounded in truth, and unafraid to say that America is worth defending. That's how movements are built. Not from the top down... But from the ground up. One student. One school. One chapter at a time. And Peter -- that's exactly how we take this country back. But only if we move fast enough. Because the Left isn't slowing down. They're not taking a break. They're not afraid to push their anti-American ideas in every classroom they're in. And if we don't match that urgency... if we don't meet that moment with equal conviction... Then the generational window Charlie Kirk opened to save our country closes. And once it closes... It closes for good. That's what's at stake. Let's not waste this moment. Let's back our brave students -- while it still matters. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. I need you to hear this clearly... Charlie Kirk wasn't just dreaming big when he called me last year about Club America's progress. He was warning us: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. Look around. Club America may be in 13% of high schools... But in the other 87%? There is no pushback against the Left. No one telling those kids the truth. Just a Leftist pipeline -- from classroom... to belief... to voting booth. And once that pipeline is complete... It 's over. Peter, this is one of the last places a patriot like you can stop it before it 's too late to save our country. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can give critical support to a young freedom fighter who will. There's still time to turn this country around... and this is one of the few ways we can actually do it -- one student, one school, one chapter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

With Cliff somewhere over the Atlantic hauling limoncello home from Italy and David celebrating a family milestone (mazel tov!), [Lawrence Winnerman](https://open.substack.com/users/314034871-lawrence-winnerman?utm_source=mentions) and [Ellie Leonard](https://open.substack.com/users/39376636-ellie-leonard?utm_source=mentions) hold down AMPED UP with special guest [Dana DuBois](https://open.substack.com/users/201342263-dana-dubois?utm_source=mentions)--and the bench shows up swinging. After a moving tribute to beloved Substacker Rosie the Resister, the trio dives into the question everyone is whispering: where is Donald Trump? Seven days unseen. Credible voices like Mike Brock alleging the unthinkable. Dr. Oz offering the dumbest non-doctor answer in television history.
The crew sorts rumor from reality--carefully, with Occam's razor in hand--and asks what it would mean for the spell to finally break.
From there, two essays collide into one argument. Dana unpacks her piece answering Dr. Oz's claim that America is "under-babied"--no, she writes, America is motherless, and she has the receipts: maternal deaths after Roe fell, vanishing OB-GYNs, a movement that demands more babies while calling women "penis homes."

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The marijuana money for Colorado schools shrank. A 2025 law decided where the rest goes.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
For years the story about Colorado’s marijuana taxes and its schools ran in one direction. Sales climbed, revenue climbed, and a share of it went to a fund that helps districts repair aging buildings. When sales started falling, the natural assumption followed. Less marijuana money, less for schools.
That assumption is incomplete, and the reason is buried in how the money is structured. The marijuana excise tax that flows to school construction has dropped to about the level the state constitution singles out for protection.
The first $40 million collected each year is reserved for construction before anything else can touch it. Marijuana collections are now close to that line, which means the protected piece is most of what’s left.

**[Prose that just happens to rhyme: Larry Gatlin on books, faith and the America worth passing on](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Gatlin is as much a literary man as a musician:** Before becoming a country star, he fell in love with books as an English major — Shakespeare, Hemingway, Faulkner, Yeats — and that reading shaped his songwriting, including his 1979 chart-topper "All the Gold in California," inspired by Steinbeck's Grapes of Wrath.
* **Faith is central to Gatlin's life and legacy:** His song "Help Me" led Kris Kristofferson to walk the aisle at a church service and write "Why Me Lord" that same afternoon — and Elvis Presley recorded the same song on his knees in the studio in 1973. Gatlin credits God, not himself, for the journey.
* **Gatlin worries America is losing its moral foundation:** Citing Allan Bloom's Closing of the American Mind and Thomas Jefferson's belief that democracy requires an educated people, he argues that relativism and cultural secularism are eroding the values — faith, patriotism, shared right and wrong — that he's actively teaching his grandchildren, one Goldfish cracker at a time.

**[Polis Signs New Law Allowing Lawsuits Against Licensed Counselors Despite Free Speech Concerns](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Polis signed HB 1322 into law Monday, allowing individuals to sue licensed providers for damages:** the all-Democrat-sponsored bill also prompted Polis to issue an executive order barring state funds from being used for conversion therapy, which he called harmful, ineffective, and a scam.
* **The law faces an immediate constitutional cloud:** critics argue it could punish providers with sincerely held religious beliefs — a concern validated just months ago when the U.S. Supreme Court ruled 8-1 in favor of Colorado Springs counselor Kaley Chiles, with Justice Gorsuch writing that any law suppressing speech based on viewpoint is an assault on First Amendment freedoms.
* **The bill passed along largely partisan lines — 40-23 in the House and 23-12 in the Senate:** supporters argued the practice is harmful and ineffective, while opponents contend that decisions about participating in such counseling should remain with families, not the government.

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
Thank you. Last night, you proved that a grassroots movement can stand up to billionaires in the heart of Silicon Valley and win.
When I supported a billionaire tax, the tech lords recruited a primary challenger and spent more than $1 million attacking me. They thought they could buy this election. They thought they could silence our movement.
They were wrong.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/103205/images/NoPAC-ThankYou-2%20%281%29.jpg]
This victory sends a message far beyond our district: the progressive movement can win anywhere when ordinary people organize, volunteer, vote, and refuse to be intimidated by wealth and power.
But our work is just beginning.
Together, we’re taking on the Epstein class and the Washington establishment. No matter how they try to intimidate us, we won’t back down.
I don’t take PAC money.
I don’t take corporate money.
I don’t take lobbyist money.
That means I couldn’t do this work without you.
From the bottom of my heart, thank you for your support, your activism, and all that you do. I’m grateful to have you in my corner.
Onward,
Ro
Wait! One more thing–
Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. A big part of that is because what Seth is saying continues to resonate, louder and louder. Seth keeps saying things other politicians are too nervous to say out loud. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132655935/625234470/2090747700?refcode=260603_hq_recap_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYWI1YjgxNC05MzVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=R0Jy7iufGdbmZdcRTaVcIIK4_n1ItjLZRzgG-3DuZRo=) Seth shows day after day what real, courageous leadership looks like.
