Peter, I hear the same kind of frustrated reaction to Democratic fundraising a lot:
**_“Why are you asking me for $5 when Trump is destroying our country and Democrats aren’t doing anything about it?”_**
I can’t speak for every group, but I do know what sets Leaders We Deserve apart.
We represent a generation of people who walked out of their schools, marching with millions of their peers to demand action on gun violence and mass shootings.
Young people are at the forefront of progressive movements, fighting for solutions on issues like gun reform, climate change, student debt, and Gaza, to name a few.
Now, these same young leaders are old enough to actually run for political office, right at the time when we need a massive movement of young people in power.
**Leaders We Deserve exists to transform these movements into political power.** Running for office is more expensive than ever — and these young leaders need our support to help lead their movements into state legislatures and Congress. We know that the billionaire class isn’t showing up to bankroll these campaigns, so it’s not an exaggeration to say they can’t win these fights without grassroots support.
**[Peter, can you contribute $5 to power our transformational movement?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260603_1_story.PbEq4v&refcode=em20260603-3556&amount=5&t=2&akid=3556%2E587540%2EQ0b6gj)**
**The young candidates that Leaders We Deserve supports are gamechangers. They will revitalize the Democratic Party and revolutionize our government.**
Our candidates are leading the fight to rebuild our political system. And they aren’t rebuilding the same political system that brought us school shootings, climate change, and everything that younger generations have to deal with in America.
They’re building something better — a system that actually _works_ for the people.
I believe that a big part of the answer to Donald Trump is building a movement of young people who will take back the reins of our government from the far right.
**Young people are up to this challenge.** If history has taught us anything, it's that great generations aren’t born, they’re made in the crucible of awful circumstances.
So when you give a donation to Leaders We Deserve, you aren’t just throwing out money at the status quo. You are investing in a different vision for what’s possible.
**[Please — pitch in $5 now to join our movement and fight for our future.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260603_1_story.PbEq4v&refcode=em20260603-3556&amount=5&t=3&akid=3556%2E587540%2EQ0b6gj)**

We can only do this work with your support. I deeply appreciate your generosity.
Thank you,
David Hogg

| | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.

clean_body: Children like Kristen are still waiting A rescue team changed Kristen's life. Another mission begins in Phoenix. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. This rescue was possible because people chose to act. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care. That is why I am reaching out to you today. Your donation today can help: Train officers to find trafficked children Support rescue operations Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors Help children begin the journey to healing When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question. What if it were my child? I could not stay silent. And you do not have to either. Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today? Your gift -- whatever God places on your heart -- will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark. Together we can make sure more children hear the Sound of Freedom. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. The cost to staff, equip, and execute a Freedom Strike Force Training Camp is $25,000. To raise these funds, I need Freedom Fighters like you to rally in support and sponsor this mission. Please pray about what you can do to help and donate today. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

| | Peter,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.
Over. And over. And over. **This is the reality of child trafficking.**

Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. **They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **This rescue was possible because people chose to act.**

clean_body: until this happened A rescue team changed Kristen's life. Another mission begins in Phoenix. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Peter,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. This rescue was possible because people chose to act. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care. That is why I am reaching out to you today. **I’m Josh Turek. I’m a Democratic state legislator who won a deep red seat, four-time Paralympian, and two-time gold medalist in wheelchair basketball.**
I thought the feeling of winning my first gold medal at the 2016 Rio Paralympics would only come once in a lifetime. But, last night the race was called:
**_I’m officially the Democratic nominee for Iowa’s open U.S. Senate seat._**
, grassroots energy usually peaks in the first few days after a primary, so we have to get down to business ASAP. [**Will you help me make the most of our hard-fought victory by splitting a donation between my campaign and****Mallory****McMorrow to become one of the first Founding Donors of my General Election campaign?**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-turek26.zlQ5MV&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260603_PM2_V1_S1&t=2&akid=4876%2E898137%2EghfuBN)

**I got into this race because like millions of fellow Democrats, I was fed up with losing, fed up with treating “red” states like lost causes and tired of perpetually playing defense.**
I won this primary because I played offense, and **I’m going to run a relentless full-court press to win this seat in November.**
I don’t take a penny of corporate PAC money. Your support, and your support _alone_ , will help us flip Iowa blue for the first time in more than a decade and take back the Senate Majority.
[**I’m personally asking you to become one of our first General Election Founding Donors by splitting a contribution of $15, $20, $35, or more today. Your contribution will power my voter outreach so I can flip Joni Ernst’s Senate seat and restore hope and faith in the great state of Iowa.**](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-turek26.zlQ5MV&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260603_PM2_V1_S1&t=4&akid=4876%2E898137%2EghfuBN)

Look, I’m under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially.
But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson.
**This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now.**
We have **152 days** to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the future.
Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost primary victory.
The outcome of this race will decide the Senate majority with huge implications for our country, so my team and I need every single solitary ounce of support to hit the ground rolling. Look, I’m under no illusions about the work it’ll take to win a battleground Senate race as a Democrat in Iowa. Taking on Joni Ernst, Ashley Hinson, and their billionaire-fueled MAGA Machine will be a beast of a challenge — physically, mentally, financially. But I’m not your average career politician. I’ve won back-to-back victories in deep red Trump country. Polls show me either tied with or one point ahead of my official Republican opponent, Ashley Hinson. This election will be a nail-biter, and it starts right now. We have 152 days to bring independents and conservatives into our Prairie Populist coalition; to overcome over $40 million in spending from MAGA megadonors; and to let the world know that working-class Americans own the future. Ads, statewide tours, and campaign infrastructure don’t come cheap, and our campaign coffers are nearly empty after a hard-fought and high-cost primary victory. The outcome of this race will decide the Senate majority with huge implications for our country, so my team and I need every single solitary ounce of support to hit the ground rolling. | | | | |
# You're Invited to our Trump Day Dinner!
---
**Tickets are now on sale at** [Oregon Conservative Caucus](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/mGXi0v7GGV0eWG9Ik8Qmow~~/AAAHURA~/LQNA8TxVtEgjva_JT7H_Ta0s4ky4X-10bRDw-oglSavvvhYAcRKrkrVLDUWXOxImVG6PqRLmZPPtvw7pA0JLbJFV8diweiBJBXz7iaAiTzWFgwjHTC4ZYzo8NfpcX6yHdLkHUxKnueWFeXvONQReFlMVjNFCBCdsPUcp0ki8fwP8i-SUGXcSu_ToJFLYeBQt) for our annual Trump Day Dinner & Awards Ceremony. This is a statewide event and you don't have to be a member to attend.)
Come celebrate America's 250th with us - and wear your finest red, white, and blue - or don a full patriotic or historic costume. Have fun with it! We've stocked up on prizes!
Jennifer Van Laar, the managing editor of RedState, is a fantastic keynote speaker. We also have Max Sherman, the Republican nominee from HD32 to talk about how we're all going to help vote out our own Benedict Arnold, Cyrus Javadi.
A gorgeous venue overlooking the Columbia River. Live and silent auctions. An hour of Americana music immediately after the event so that you can sit and chat with like-minded friends - or dance! BBQ ribs, fried chicken, mashed potatoes - the works!
_If you'd like to sponsor a table for 10 and bring a bunch of your closest friends, we can hook you up._ Email info@oregonconservativecaucus.com. We might be adding a bit to the lineup as well. Follow our Facebook or X feed for updates.
We're all volunteers in the OCC and if you want to know what the proceeds we bring in are used for, it's easy: voter education, registering voters, and getting out the vote. As we near the fall, our GOTV efforts will help every Republican campaign effort across the board.
Sales cut off a couple days before the event, so [get those tickets soon.](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/mGXi0v7GGV0eWG9Ik8Qmow~~/AAAHURA~/LQNA8TxVtEgjva_JT7H_Ta0s4ky4X-10bRDw-oglSavvvhYAcRKrkrVLDUWXOxImVG6PqRLmZPPtvw7pA0JLbJFV8diweiBJBXz7iaAiTzWFgwjHTC4ZYzo8NfpcX6yHdLkHUxKnueWFeXvONQReFlMVjNFCBCdsPUcp0ki8fwP8i-SUGXcSu_ToJFLYeBQt)

Trump knows his control of Congress is hanging by a thread. So instead of making life better for the American people, he’s doing what he always does: trying to rig the system to hold on to power. And EMILYs List women are fighting back. = | = Mail-in voting is secure, legitimate, and essential for millions of Americans — including working parents, caregivers, seniors, voters with disabilities, members of the military, and people who simply can’t make it to the polls on Election Day. In fact, nearly one in three Americans voted by mail during the 2024 election — adding up to about 48 million votes. And despite Trump’s years of attacks on mail-in voting — despite him calling it a “terrible thing” and falsely claiming it’s “rampant with fraud” — he has voted by mail himself in multiple elections. Because here’s the truth, Peter: Trump doesn’t actually have a problem with mail-in voting. He has a problem knowing that this November, voters will reject him, his MAGA cronies, and his corrupt agenda at the ballot box. Whether people vote by mail, vote early in person, or vote at the polls on Election Day, Trump knows what’s coming. And now he’s trying to make it harder for millions of people to cast their ballots. body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Honoring two longtime TOP fighters for justice
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Lucille%20Spencer%20and%20Sylvia%20Collins.jpg]
The TOP community is deeply saddened by the recent passing of two powerful community advocates and longtime Dallas members of our organization, Lucille Spencer and Sylvia Collins.
For years, Ms. Lucille Spencer's heartwarming presence was felt in TOP's spaces. Lucille embodied grit and compassion -- all while never shying away from imparting wisdom, extending love, speaking up for what’s right. Ms. Spencer found her way to TOP in pursuit of justice for her son, Ben Spencer, who for over three decades was incarcerated due to a wrongful conviction. After years of relentless advocacy with TOP and other justice reform groups, Ms. Spencer saw justice for Ben arrive in 2021, as her son was finally released from prison. Ms. Spencer's unwavering faith, determination, and belief in the power of community fueled her fight that led to Ben's release.
Sylvia Collins was a fierce advocate for social justice and a powerful voice in the Dallas community. She often stood with her fist raised high - a symbol of her unwavering commitment to the causes and people she fought for. Sylvia was among those who lost their lives in an apartment explosion last week in North Oak Cliff. Our hearts are with her family, friends, and all those impacted by this tragedy. Her legacy of courage, advocacy, and service will not be forgotten.
TOP stands on the shoulders of powerful change-makers like Lucille Spencer and Sylvia Collins , women who tirelessly fought for a world where — no matter your race, age, income level, or nationality — all people are treated and seen as equal with inherent rights, with the means to truly live free and thrive. Rest in power, Lucille and Sylvia.
NEXT THURSDAY: Data Centers Movie and Discussion
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Data%20Center%20event.png]
RSVP TODAY! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2] – J oin TOP on Thursday, June 11 at 6 p.m. the historic Texas Theatre in Dallas for a FREE documentary screening and discussion with community members to learn about data centers and how they can impact our communities.
From city to city across the country, these huge facilities are bringing with them higher water bills, increased pollution, and public health risks, while straining on our already unstable energy grid.
Reserve your FREE seat today [https://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2] , and bring a friend!
📆 Thursday, June 11th at 6 p.m.
📍 Texas Theatre (231 Jefferson Blvd.)
🏆 Attendees have a chance to win a $100 gift card
For more information, contact Jet at (469) 550-4750.
http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2 [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2]
ADD YOUR NAME: Sign the Willing to Fight Pledge
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
If we want to stop harmful actions on our democracy and communities, we need millions of people fighting back together in peaceful and impactful ways. That's why TOP is proud to team up with our friends at the Organizing Revival Network to share their Willing to Fight Pledge, as we look to unite Texans on a vision that moves ALL communities forward.
👉🏾 TAKE ACTION NOW: Sign the pledge today! [https://www.willingtofight.org/orn]
TOP Tip: Celebrate and take action for Pride!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2026%20June%20-%20Pride%20Month.jpg]
TOP reaffirms its solidarity with our LGBTQIA+ community, especially our Black and Latino brothers and sisters, with Pride Month starting this week. It’s a time of reflection, celebration, and growth, as we honor all who've protested, fought injustice, and put their lives on the line to build bridges to win the societal progress we've made — while reminding ourselves of the vital work we face now to defend this progress and move us closer to collective liberation.
Check out these meaningful ways how you can celebrate and honor Pride throughout the month. [https://www.goodgoodgood.co/articles/how-to-celebrate-pride-month]

Español
Homenaje a dos veteranos luchadores de TOP por la justicia
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Lucille%20Spencer%20and%20Sylvia%20Collins.jpg]
La comunidad de TOP lamenta profundamente el reciente fallecimiento de dos poderosas defensoras comunitarias y miembros de nuestra organización en Dallas desde hace mucho tiempo: Lucille Spencer y Sylvia Collins.
Durante años, la cálida presencia de la Sra. Lucille Spencer se hizo sentir en los espacios de TOP. Lucille encarnó la perseverancia y la compasión, sin dejar de compartir su sabiduría, brindar amor y alzar la voz por lo que es justo. La Sra. Spencer llegó a TOP en busca de justicia para su hijo, Ben Spencer, quien pasó más de tres décadas encarcelado debido a una condena injusta. Después de años de incansable lucha junto a TOP y otros grupos de reforma judicial, la Sra. Spencer pudo ver cómo finalmente llegaba la justicia para Ben en 2021, cuando su hijo fue liberado de prisión. La fe inquebrantable, la determinación y la creencia de la Sra. Spencer en el poder de la comunidad fueron la fuerza que impulsó su lucha y que contribuyó a la liberación de Ben.
Sylvia Collins fue una firme defensora de la justicia social y una voz poderosa en la comunidad de Dallas. A menudo se le veía con el puño en alto, un símbolo de su compromiso inquebrantable con las causas y las personas por las que luchaba. Sylvia fue una de las personas que perdió la vida en la explosión de un complejo de apartamentos ocurrida la semana pasada en North Oak Cliff. Nuestros corazones están con su familia, amistades y con todas las personas afectadas por esta tragedia. Su legado de valentía, lucha, servicio y defensa de la comunidad nunca será olvidado.
TOP se sostiene sobre los hombros de poderosas agentes de cambio como Lucille Spencer y Sylvia Collins , quienes lucharon incansablemente por un mundo donde todas las personas — sin importar su raza, edad, nivel de ingresos o nacionalidad — sean tratadas y reconocidas como iguales, con derechos inherentes y con las oportunidades necesarias para vivir verdaderamente libres y prosperar. Que descansen en poder, Lucille y Sylvia.
EL PRÓXIMO JUEVES: Película y debate sobre centros de datos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Data%20Center%20event.png]
¡CONFIRME SU ASISTENCIA HOY MISMO! [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2] – Acompañe a TOP el jueves 11 de junio a las 6 p.m. en el histórico Texas Theatre de Dallas para asistir a la proyección GRATUITA de un documental y participar en un diálogo con miembros de la comunidad, con el fin de aprender sobre los centros de datos y cómo estos pueden impactar a nuestras comunidades.
De ciudad en ciudad, a lo largo y ancho del país, estas enormes instalaciones traen consigo facturas de agua más elevadas, un aumento de la contaminación y riesgos para la salud pública, al tiempo que ejercen una presión adicional sobre nuestra ya inestable red energética.
¡Reserve hoy mismo su asiento GRATUITO [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2] y traiga a un amigo!
📆 Jueves 11 de junio a las 6 p.m.
📍 Texas Theatre (231 Jefferson Blvd.)
🏆 Los asistentes tendrán la oportunidad de ganar una tarjeta de regalo de $100.
Para más información, comuníquese con Jet al (469) 550-4750
http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2 [http://secure.ngpvan.com/brQtPZN3UUCF83a4PjDSHw2]
AÑADE TU NOMBRE: Firma el Compromiso de Luchar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hear%20America.png]
Si queremos detener las acciones perjudiciales contra nuestra democracia y nuestras comunidades, necesitamos que millones de personas se unan para responder de manera pacífica y efectiva. Por eso, TOP se enorgullece de colaborar con nuestros aliados de Organizing Revival Network para compartir su Compromiso de Estar Dispuestos a Luchar, mientras buscamos unir a los tejanos en torno a una visión que impulse el progreso de TODAS las comunidades.
👉🏾 ACTÚA AHORA: ¡Firma el compromiso hoy mismo! [https://www.willingtofight.org/orn]
Consejos de TOP: Celebra y actúa por el Mes del
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/2026%20June%20-%20Pride%20Month.jpg]
TOP reafirma su solidaridad con nuestra comunidad LGBTQIA+, especialmente con nuestros hermanos y hermanas negros y latinos, al dar comienzo esta semana el Mes del Orgullo. Es un momento de reflexión, celebración y crecimiento, en el que honramos a todos aquellos que han protestado, luchado contra la injusticia y arriesgado sus vidas para construir los puentes que hace posible el progreso social que hemos alcanzado; al mismo tiempo, nos recordamos a nosotros mismos la labor vital que tenemos por delante ahora para defender este progreso y acercarnos a la liberación colectiva.
Descubre estas significativas formas en las que puedes celebrar y honrar el Orgullo a lo largo de todo el mes. [http://www.goodgoodgood.co/articles/how-to-celebrate-pride-month]

Nuestros corazones están con su familia, amistades y con todas las personas afectadas por esta tragedia. Su legado de valentía, lucha, servicio y defensa de la comunidad nunca será olvidado. TOP se sostiene sobre los hombros de poderosas agentes de cambio como Lucille Spencer y Sylvia Collins , quienes lucharon incansablemente por un mundo donde todas las personas — sin importar su raza, edad, nivel de ingresos o nacionalidad — sean tratadas y reconocidas como iguales, con derechos inherentes y con las oportunidades necesarias para vivir verdaderamente libres y prosperar. Que descansen en poder, Lucille y Sylvia. EL PRÓXIMO JUEVES: Película y debate sobre centros de datos [] ¡CONFIRME SU ASISTENCIA HOY MISMO! [] – Acompañe a TOP el jueves 11 de junio a las 6 p.m. en el histórico Texas Theatre de Dallas para asistir a la proyección GRATUITA de un documental y participar en un diálogo con miembros de la comunidad, con el fin de aprender sobre los centros de datos y cómo estos pueden impactar a nuestras comunidades. De ciudad en ciudad, a lo largo y ancho del país, estas enormes instalaciones traen consigo facturas de agua más elevadas, un aumento de la contaminación y riesgos para la salud pública, al tiempo que ejercen una presión adicional sobre nuestra ya inestable red energética. ¡Reserve hoy mismo su asiento GRATUITO [] y traiga a un amigo! 📆 Jueves 11 de junio a las 6 p.m. 📍 Texas Theatre (231 Jefferson Blvd.) 🏆 Los asistentes tendrán la oportunidad de ganar una tarjeta de regalo de $100. Para más información, comuníquese con Jet al (469) 550-4750 [] AÑADE TU NOMBRE: Firma el Compromiso de Luchar [] Si queremos detener las acciones perjudiciales contra nuestra democracia y nuestras comunidades, necesitamos que millones de personas se unan para responder de manera pacífica y efectiva. Por eso, TOP se enorgullece de colaborar con nuestros aliados de Organizing Revival Network para compartir su Compromiso de Estar Dispuestos a Luchar, mientras buscamos unir a los tejanos en torno a una visión que impulse el progreso de TODAS las comunidades. 👉🏾 ACTÚA AHORA: ¡Firma el compromiso hoy mismo! [] Consejos de TOP: Celebra y actúa por el Mes del [] TOP reafirma su solidaridad con nuestra comunidad LGBTQIA+, especialmente con nuestros hermanos y hermanas negros y latinos, al dar comienzo esta semana el Mes del Orgullo. Es un momento de reflexión, celebración y crecimiento, en el que honramos a todos aquellos que han protestado, luchado contra la injusticia y arriesgado sus vidas para construir los puentes que hace posible el progreso social que hemos alcanzado; al mismo tiempo, nos recordamos a nosotros mismos la labor vital que tenemos por delante ahora para defender este progreso y acercarnos a la liberación colectiva. Descubre estas significativas formas en las que puedes celebrar y honrar el Orgullo a lo largo de todo el mes. [] [] Copyright (C) 2026 Texas Organizing Project. All rights reserved. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces. In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud. In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson. In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others. In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime. Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? Peter, The extreme conservative effort to steal power from the people and hand it to those at the top just got another boost from the captured Supreme Court. **Last night, the Supreme Court handed down an order allowing Alabama to use a congressional map that slashes Black congressional representation in half.** [****](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9FmfThJYf2BhJjru3yZF27_GRU2101eC8Z200UVf-KFAj_XCODie9HSpDeZLYrlIanIT8Gr_oUoSWLq8uFQuiBRpvmWlVWFOHwvEaZvqL10O_T8jkwwKUTaLr6zLcXYPnaiRC7xRHkTu8wY9d58V4xKK4EthLaRLxEgf8NzhzfmZQri_hO1AECQ3A2WYpr8cro9-OLaVgnF9F_ZXhSHQHC7GsuOiFo75C0jRhPTFhwEPEQkVOl-af2qJdlc1YlVtG-mCRZutPd01J3jnnVQGOtjGd7--y1E9ocjrrygM4FCosEtNP1ZzBcfW69Emn1gdihY/4r6/2pUwFaOzRnS09nh6_3oHlw/h0/h001.jRwXGPszsytyNQXsUNxZpuxwmcUERppNVCRpO_HsLzQ) A federal three-judge court had found that the maps were intentionally racist. The Supreme Court’s conservative majority looked at that finding and said: Proceed anyway. **This ruling comes just weeks after the Court gutted what was left of the Voting Rights Act—and it tells you everything you need to know about who these justices serve.** In the wake of _Louisiana v. Callais_ , red states across the South now working to reshape districts with large minority populations and influence elections on behalf of Republicans. And this Supreme Court isn’t just issuing decisions, it’s actively helping rig the system. **Our political system isn’t broken—it’s working exactly as its wealthy and extreme donors designed it to work.** **This moment calls for serious, large-scale reform. Small fixes aren’t going to cut it. It’s up to Congress to put together a plan to bring power back to the people and demand accountability from the captured Supreme Court.** [**We can’t sit back and allow these rigged decisions to stand, We the People must call on every member of Congress to publicly commit to a plan to give people their power back. Figures’ seat in Congress.** Figures was elected under a court-imposed fair map by voters who wanted him to represent them in Congress. Now, his seat and their voices have been stolen. His constituents will now find themselves dispersed into heavily Republican, majority-white districts, where their votes are meant to count less. **This is what a coordinated effort to concentrate power away from Black voters and communities of color looks like.** **And who benefits? The political interests that built and packed this Supreme Court in the first place. They’re getting exactly what they paid for.** The Court and the powers behind them want us to feel defeated and powerless. But we refuse to stand down. The communities of Alabama’s Second District have fought for fair representation for generations. They will keep fighting, and so will we. **We the People deserve a political system that is fair, accountable, and capable of delivering for everyone—not one that rewards states for intentional discrimination.** [**We’re demanding Congress commit to a plan to give us our power back in the wake of the Supreme Court’s attacks on voting rights, democracy, and Black representation. body:
As FHFA Director, Bill Pulte used federal mortgage records to go after Trump’s political opponents.
#
Peter,
If any of you felt a bit of relief when Tulsi Gabbard resigned as Director of National Intelligence, we’ve got some bad news.
Trump’s put up a guy named Bill Pulte for the post. A lot of people are making hay about him coming from real estate and the Federal Housing Finance Agency, and that’s disqualifying in its own right. The DNI is required, by law, to have extensive experience in intelligence work.
But that’s actually not the half of it. As FHFA Director, Bill Pulte used federal mortgage records to go after Trump’s political opponents. The guy literally is using all the information at his disposal to cook up fraud allegations against people Trump doesn’t like for one reason or another.
Imagine what he’ll do as Director of National Intelligence, overseeing each and every US intelligence agency. He’ll be more focused on protecting Trump than our National Security — and when that happens, it doesn't just put civilians at risk. When the DNI messes up, American Troops get killed.
We’ve got to mobilize **_now_** if we’re going to have any chance at stopping this. There is already pushback on Capitol Hill against Pulte’s nomination and we have to supercharge it. We have to make him so politically toxic that the Senate votes him down.
That starts here and now.
[**Peter, we’re asking you to DEMAND the Senate reject Bill Pulte’s nomination as Director of National Intelligence. Tell them the American people won’t give Trump free rein to weaponize the surveillance state, and do it now.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260603_no_to_pulte_em/?source=em260603-1-160&refcode2=35196.3013755.TqbQCm&akid=35196%2E3013755%2ETqbQCm)

| | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.

Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. **They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **This rescue was possible because people chose to act.**

clean_body: From an attic to freedom A rescue team changed Kristen's life. Another mission begins in Phoenix. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. This rescue was possible because people chose to act. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care. That is why I am reaching out to you today. Your donation today can help: Train officers to find trafficked children Support rescue operations Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors Help children begin the journey to healing When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question. What if it were my child? I could not stay silent. And you do not have to either. Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today? Your gift -- whatever God places on your heart -- will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark. Together we can make sure more children hear the Sound of Freedom. With gratitude and prayer, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation P.S. The cost to staff, equip, and execute a Freedom Strike Force Training Camp is $25,000. To raise these funds, I need Freedom Fighters like you to rally in support and sponsor this mission. Please pray about what you can do to help and donate today. 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132660858/625249788/1231236074?refcode=RS_EM_FR_2026.06.03_MayNewsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MDU3Y2I3Ny1hMjVmLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6_mnhQndX2OHI7GNusygL-SrvaI9GZsiErLile6rQyA=&emci=3f3c4803-5c5f-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=5057cb77-a25f-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=23483442) | Hey, Peter. **May was all about one question:** _Why are working families paying more while Republicans in the other Washington keep prioritizing everything except lowering costs?_ **Putting my foot down** — I voted NO on the Republican budget that did absolutely nothing to lower costs for working families. Instead of helping Americans afford groceries, gas, healthcare, or childcare, Republicans proposed billions in new spending for immigration enforcement and other Trump administration priorities. Working people deserve a budget that lowers costs and invests in their future, not one that ignores the challenges they face every day. **Protecting what makes Washington special** — I continued the fight to protect our public lands and preserve the natural beauty of the Olympic Peninsula. As the Trump administration pushed to weaken protections for roadless areas, I spoke out in support of the Roadless Rule and renewed my commitment to passing the Wild Olympics Wilderness & Wild and Scenic Rivers Act. Protecting our forests, rivers, and Tribal ancestral lands is about safeguarding these places for future generations. **Making life more affordable** — Families across our district are feeling squeezed by rising costs and stagnant wages. As Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus Better Pay and Benefits Task Force, I’m working with my colleagues to advance policies that put working people first. From lowering costs to strengthening pay and benefits, we're focused on building an economy that works for everyone. **Hearing directly from you** — I met with constituents at town halls in Gig Harbor and Chimacum to answer questions, hear concerns, and discuss my work in Congress. Our Gig Harbor event featured members of my Youth Leadership Council, and it was inspiring to hear directly from young people about the issues that matter most to them. clean_body: | Hey, Peter. May was all about one question: Why are working families paying more while Republicans in the other Washington keep prioritizing everything except lowering costs? Putting my foot down — I voted NO on the Republican budget that did absolutely nothing to lower costs for working families. Instead of helping Americans afford groceries, gas, healthcare, or childcare, Republicans proposed billions in new spending for immigration enforcement and other Trump administration priorities. Working people deserve a budget that lowers costs and invests in their future, not one that ignores the challenges they face every day. Protecting what makes Washington special — I continued the fight to protect our public lands and preserve the natural beauty of the Olympic Peninsula. As the Trump administration pushed to weaken protections for roadless areas, I spoke out in support of the Roadless Rule and renewed my commitment to passing the Wild Olympics Wilderness & Wild and Scenic Rivers Act. Protecting our forests, rivers, and Tribal ancestral lands is about safeguarding these places for future generations. Making life more affordable — Families across our district are feeling squeezed by rising costs and stagnant wages. As Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus Better Pay and Benefits Task Force, I’m working with my colleagues to advance policies that put working people first. From lowering costs to strengthening pay and benefits, we're focused on building an economy that works for everyone. Hearing directly from you — I met with constituents at town halls in Gig Harbor and Chimacum to answer questions, hear concerns, and discuss my work in Congress. Our Gig Harbor event featured members of my Youth Leadership Council, and it was inspiring to hear directly from young people about the issues that matter most to them. These conversations help ensure that your priorities guide my work in Washington, D.C. = = **The truth is that too many people feel like the other Washington isn't listening to them. I believe government should work for everyday people. I’m not here to represent special interests, billionaires, or political insiders. That's why I'm fighting for lower costs, better pay, stronger public services, and protections for our public lands. = = Thank you so much 💙 — Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. She grew up in a working-class Union household in Port Orchard and was the first in her family to attend college. After serving in the State Senate and passing nearly 200 bills, Emily made history in 2024 as the first queer Latina elected to Congress. Now, Emily is fighting for WA working families in D.C. and organizing to take back the House. body:
We are building something different — and voters everywhere are taking notice. | | | Peter, Millions of ballots are still being counted in California. And although we may not have a full picture of the results for a few more days, one thing is clear: **yesterday was a historic day for the California Working Families Party:**
* **Jane Kim** is leading the field and poised to win first place statewide for CA Insurance Commissioner, where she would lead the fight to lower health care costs, guarantee coverage, and hold greedy insurance companies accountable.
* **Randy Villegas** is currently in second place in CA-22 and is in a good position to make it to the general election in one of the hottest battleground districts in the nation, with Republican incumbent David Valadao currently under 50%.
* **Connie Chan** has advanced to November in CA-11, where she’ll have a chance to replace former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and bring a bold pro-worker and affordability vision to Congress.
* **Mai Vang** , who fought tirelessly for working families on the Sacramento City Council and secured $10 million in annual funding for low-income children, is currently in position to advance to November in CA-07.
* And WFP-endorsed **Aisha Wahab** — the first Afghan American woman to be elected to public office in the United States — is currently in first place in her race in CA-14.

It’s all part of a growing trend that we’ve seen across the country this primary season: **voters are rejecting Democrats who are funded by the same corporate interests as Republicans, and backing candidates who are actually committed to standing up to billionaires instead.** But there’s no time to rest. WFP candidates for Congress are running in primaries _every week for the rest of this month_ , including DC on June 16th, New York and Maryland on June 23rd, and Colorado on June 30th. **Dozens of our WFP champions are on the ballot in these next four weeks overall, and we need your support to keep this momentum going.** [Pitch in today to help put even more WFP champions into office. We’re getting out the vote for pro-worker, anti-billionaire candidates for Congress and nearly every other level of office across the country. Your support is how we win.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9J2scZD6mFOlKf2qCtSDGGxKVt5vV7Y3xzzWKpeXA0KPbmZNGIacZSkE16v5OcL_rD2__j_fQxzmVnqPoUASiYxBtr6jrMMGcnh_UwBjs9YhUK95KrkZabikL_YOeWSh-tN-3Js6cFU0TpKHE2G-u15AlqKWWA-n9FkWfCeOIWmglLnn6FpT8EK3e8HqDzAXhGPIM3O9qVCq5Cxvj-KeuUlmoq3BUdetJ20LbVjMVjw9BwOTRFO7w8HnyP5kTkH8cH5V-FczT-QeoSqN_N48XoVQ-QjsDROvVFOCi5fKmRsGDFKCWZoa1vsERnj5NS1SyJZuh71SW4VeJjsQ2NLbfRg/4r6/Kz4X_ngITUmTEYRUZLySuw/h0/h001.C3iI_QBpi3dsT2BMhoy3sfoUvMhuTZqDqFgMpdp8YwI) **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9J2scZD6mFOlKf2qCtSDGGxKVt5vV7Y3xzzWKpeXA0KM3xsvndUpIBOLfpey9kpLKpWxemoLyhrPRuUf6rUZqdl2FT1ZnZQBjQIGwbtVM3yuWSiyiQ-yDv9AGlYb-3ti8W9_Q-YBHo0vvd2feYDYxt6Fk-m8HwCsOL_Vj6wbbu_psMLlRgwbD_69LbRPqJNKUo_QoV-w_mQXCppuj5z80KhpEXk9K7kbaixei58sCKAGUdQGkzKh4OUFeeE7HPMAMNrorbhf6uHVu0PzvuTX_ORR4y6cflVcP5oMt_pTtyv9hqyZkzNX7we3cmq1mdToSREBrCgFAUnAWNpP5oI9fmA/4r6/Kz4X_ngITUmTEYRUZLySuw/h1/h001.0vQe9WNqyvdxl6Erf4JIz9gOKNR0clKFzSNt_RS818o)** WFP candidates are delivering political shockwave after political shockwave in 2026. And it’s no surprise as to why: Trump, the Republican party, and the billionaire class who backs them have been running roughshod over working families since he entered office. They’ve continued to enable the genocide in Gaza, and dragged us into a historically unpopular war with Iran. They’ve sold out working people to put money in their own pockets, while families can barely afford to put food on the table. And all the while, too many Democrats have not shown the backbone to _fight back_. **The Working Families Party is building something different — and voters everywhere are taking notice.** Our candidates are putting working class people at the forefront of their political vision. We’re demanding a home you can afford — lower rents, mortgages, and utilities. Health care you can rely on — guaranteed for all. Better jobs to support your families — raising wages and placing workers in union jobs. Childcare when and where you need it, paid family and medical leave, and so much more. **But in order to make this vision a reality, we can’t just rely on Democrats taking back the House and Senate. We need to elect more working class leaders to office. clean_body: We are building something different — and voters everywhere are taking notice. | | | Peter, Millions of ballots are still being counted in California. And although we may not have a full picture of the results for a few more days, one thing is clear: yesterday was a historic day for the California Working Families Party: Jane Kim is leading the field and poised to win first place statewide for CA Insurance Commissioner, where she would lead the fight to lower health care costs, guarantee coverage, and hold greedy insurance companies accountable. Randy Villegas is currently in second place in CA-22 and is in a good position to make it to the general election in one of the hottest battleground districts in the nation, with Republican incumbent David Valadao currently under 50%. Connie Chan has advanced to November in CA-11, where she’ll have a chance to replace former House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and bring a bold pro-worker and affordability vision to Congress. Mai Vang , who fought tirelessly for working families on the Sacramento City Council and secured $10 million in annual funding for low-income children, is currently in position to advance to November in CA-07. And WFP-endorsed Aisha Wahab — the first Afghan American woman to be elected to public office in the United States — is currently in first place in her race in CA-14. It’s all part of a growing trend that we’ve seen across the country this primary season: voters are rejecting Democrats who are funded by the same corporate interests as Republicans, and backing candidates who are actually committed to standing up to billionaires instead. But there’s no time to rest. WFP candidates for Congress are running in primaries every week for the rest of this month , including DC on June 16th, New York and Maryland on June 23rd, and Colorado on June 30th. Dozens of our WFP champions are on the ballot in these next four weeks overall, and we need your support to keep this momentum going. WFP candidates are delivering political shockwave after political shockwave in 2026. And it’s no surprise as to why: Trump, the Republican party, and the billionaire class who backs them have been running roughshod over working families since he entered office. They’ve continued to enable the genocide in Gaza, and dragged us into a historically unpopular war with Iran. They’ve sold out working people to put money in their own pockets, while families can barely afford to put food on the table. And all the while, too many Democrats have not shown the backbone to fight back. The Working Families Party is building something different — and voters everywhere are taking notice. Our candidates are putting working class people at the forefront of their political vision. We’re demanding a home you can afford — lower rents, mortgages, and utilities. Health care you can rely on — guaranteed for all. Better jobs to support your families — raising wages and placing workers in union jobs. Childcare when and where you need it, paid family and medical leave, and so much more. But in order to make this vision a reality, we can’t just rely on Democrats taking back the House and Senate. We need to elect more working class leaders to office. And from now until November, we have a rare opportunity to elect hundreds more WFP champions in several key states. subject: On 603 Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
As one of the few states left with a single area code, it’s a constant reminder of how connected our communities really are.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=7002%2E582294%2EXuaxFQ)
Happy 603 Day, team!
The 603 area code has covered all of New Hampshire since 1947.
And as one of the few states left with a single area code, it’s a constant reminder of how connected our communities really are. Granite Staters look out for their neighbors, focus on keeping their towns strong, and are incredibly proud of where they live.
**That’s what this campaign is about.**
We are fighting to lower costs, ensure families can afford to stay in the communities they love, and bring some actual common sense to Washington.
**[So in the spirit of 603 Day, I’m asking you to make a small contribution today – $6.03 – to support our campaign for the U.S. Senate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260603_3._UA9tj&refcode=em20260603-3&t=2&akid=7002%2E582294%2EXuaxFQ)**

Unlike our opponents this campaign is powered by people across New Hampshire – not corporate special interests. But it’s going to take a lot of folks stepping up to compete in what’s expected to be one of the closest, most expensive races in the country.

Chris

| | | | | | Peter,
While there are still votes to count, **we’re currently at over 65% of the vote** and feel confident that, with your support, I will serve a third and final term on the School Board.
With these results, we also feel confident in the direction that L.A. Unified is headed on issues such as reducing screen time, increasing wraparound supports for students, and expanding preschool options throughout L.A.
I of course could not have done this without all of your support! You donated, you volunteered, you spread the word, and, most importantly, you voted — and I am beyond grateful.
A good friend of mine often says that nobody votes to say thank you. What he means is that voters don’t select candidates based on past accomplishments; **they choose the vision they want for the future.** We presented a strong vision for the future of L.A. schools, and I look forward to working over the next four years to get it done.
Thank you for your continued faith and support.
With gratitude,
